Description.SourceString:
作为猎手，偶尔也要换换口味，最近绯莎对一种从未谋面的海洋生物萌生兴趣，为了与之相见她换上一身清凉，甚至模仿起了那种生物的样貌。

【“海豚是游泳冠军？呵，与我相比呢？”】
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString: 为心夏特制的狙击作战服，功能齐全，造型稳重，适合全天候作战条件。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's custom sniper suit is fully functional with a modest design, suitable for all weather conditions.

Description.SourceString: 心夏狙击作战服的备用款，浅浅的樱色令人心情舒畅。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's spare sniper combat uniform. The light pink lifts the spirits.

Description.SourceString: 心夏狙击作战服的备用款，灰蓝交杂，如天空映衬群山。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's spare sniper combat uniform. The mix of gray and blue resembles the sky over the mountains.

Description.SourceString: 心夏狙击作战服的备用款，碧蓝如秋日苍穹。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's spare sniper combat uniform in azure, resembling the autumn sky.

Description.SourceString: 心夏狙击作战服的备用款，浅紫为衬，宛如暮色。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's spare sniper combat uniform in light purple, resembling the twilight.

Description.SourceString: 心夏狙击作战服的备用款，迷彩绿正适合潜伏行动。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's spare sniper combat uniform in green camouflage, perfect for stealth operations.

Description.SourceString: 心夏狙击作战服的备用款，淡淡的草色令人有些惆怅。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's spare sniper combat uniform in light green, making one feel melancholic.

Description.SourceString: 心夏狙击作战服的备用款，红白相间配色，适用于医疗救援行动。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's spare sniper combat uniform in red and white, suitable for medical operations.

Description.SourceString: 心夏狙击作战服的备用款，配色取自沙砾与枯木，在戈壁滩有着良好的伪装效果。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's spare sniper combat uniform, inspired by sand and dry wood colors, offers excellent camouflage in the Gobi Desert.

Description.SourceString: 工程服款式的战斗装饰，饰以玩闹一般的工地标识。这套服装，是在心夏过去的探险生涯中所留下的纪念品。
Description.LocalizedString: An engineer-styled combat suit, adorned with playful construction site markings. This outfit is a memento from Kokona's past adventures.

Description.SourceString: 心夏作战服的改造款式，将白虎的条纹融入服装设计中。在她身上，这套作战服英武非凡，却也有一股掩不住的危险气息。
Description.LocalizedString: A modified version of Kokona's combat uniform, incorporating the stripes of a white tiger into the design. Donning this outfit, she appears exceptionally valiant and undeniably dangerous.

Description.SourceString: 像是出租司机一样的工作装，却因穿着者而变得格外出挑亮眼。心夏说，这是她掩饰身份的行动装束，但，这是真的吗？
Description.LocalizedString: A work outfit similar to that of a taxi driver, yet exceptionally striking because of the wearer. Kokona says it is her disguise, but is that really the case?

Description.SourceString: 绘有雪花与松林的高雅服装，在心夏身上更显雅致。其中的含义，恐怕也只有她一人知晓。
Description.LocalizedString: An elegant outfit with snowflake and pine tree patterns becomes even more graceful on Kokona. She alone may understand its true significance.

Description.SourceString: 捡贝壳、挖螃蟹……将清新的夏日海滩印在身上，就能随时享受沙滩寻宝的乐趣了。
Description.LocalizedString: Picking up shells, digging for crabs... Wear the summer beach on your body to enjoy the joy of beach treasure hunting at any time.

Description.SourceString: 据说在某个遥远的国度，一位探索者为了追寻世界的真理曾数次追逐太阳，当地的人们便将她的事迹以壁画的形式记录了下来。我想我们知道她是谁。
Description.LocalizedString: Legend speaks of an explorer from a distant land who chased the sun in search of truth. Her story, captured in local murals, hints at a familiar figure we might recognize.

Description.SourceString:
虚拟偶像“达克鸭鸭”的演唱会应援服，前卫新潮，又不失少女的活泼俏皮，是心夏珍藏已久的绝版款。

【“心夏前辈，准备好了吗？达克鸭鸭的演唱会要开始了哦！”
“那是当然……哎呀！”
“怎，怎么回事？远方一阵轰鸣……”
“有情况！执行紧急任务！”
就这样，少女身着应援服饰，第一时间奔赴前线。】
Description.LocalizedString:
A fun outfit for the concert of Duckyucky, the virtual idol. With a cute avant-garde design, this limited outfit is treasured by Kokona.

"Are you ready, Kokona? Duckyucky's concert is about to start!"
"Of course... Oh no!"
"W-What's going on? What was that noise...?"
"Something's happening! Emergency mission!"
And so, the girl, dressed in her fun outfit, rushes to the front line.

Description.SourceString:
模仿了旧时代电影中的飞行员装扮，寄托了心夏未竟的梦想。自幼便对世界充满好奇的她总是向往着天空和远方的大地，希望用自己的眼睛去见证未知的土地。

【“我看看，这个是操纵杆，这个是高度计……好了，别担心，我已经看过好几十遍操作手册了。记好弹射开关的位置，我们准备起飞了！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Inspired by flight suits from old movies, this outfit reflects Kokona's unfulfilled dreams. Ever curious, she has always yearned for the sky and distant lands, eager to explore the unknown.

“Let's see. This is the center stick, and that is the altimeter... Relax. I've read the manual dozens of times. Remember where to pull to activate the ejection seat. We're taking off!”

Description.SourceString:
心夏作为太空体验馆的导游时所穿着的衣物，具有抗辐射功能的装束非常适合外宇宙工程师的工作，作为工作的报酬，这件衣服被太空馆送给了心夏。

【“宇航员心夏，现已出舱，感觉良好~”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The outfit Kokona wears as a guide at the Space Center features radiation protection, making it ideal for space engineers.

"Astronaut Kokona out of the spacecraft and reporting for duty. I'm feeling great!"

Description.SourceString:
心夏尝试改造的野外装备之一，原本是用来探险的装束，在心夏的改造下变成了适合出游和野餐的礼仪性服装，说起来，身上的草莓似乎是真的可以吃的。

【“感兴趣的话，要来吃吃看吗？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A piece of outdoor gear modified by Kokona. Originally intended for exploration, it has been transformed into a ceremonial outfit suitable for outings and picnics. Speaking of which, the strawberries on the outfit seem to be edible.

“If you're interested, feel free to have a bite.”

Description.SourceString:
心夏参加秋季山地骑行比赛时的服装，贴身而轻便，透气性与降低风阻方面的表现非常优异，同时配备了容量充足的工具包。据说心夏就是穿着这身衣服，轻松拿下了骑行比赛的冠军。

【“很意外吗？小小的身体偶尔也会爆发出惊人的能量！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The outfit Kokona wears to mountain biking competitions in the fall. Light and durable, it offers excellent breathability and wind resistance reduction and comes equipped with a sufficient tool kit. Rumor has it that Kokona won the championship wearing this outfit.

"Are you surprised? Great power lies in my body!"

Description.SourceString:
心夏在金树乐章音乐会时准备的演出礼服，可爱的小礼帽彰显着俏皮和活力，对于挑战充满着期待。

【“要来试试四手联弹吗？指挥不懂的话怎么能做好指挥的工作呢？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The formal dress Kokona prepared for the Golden Tree Symphony concert, featuring a cute little hat that showcases her playfulness and eagerness for the challenge.

"Care to try a piano duet? How can a conductor excel without understanding the music?"

Description.SourceString:
心夏参加海滨祭典暨美食大会时的服装。四方各路的美食达人汇集于此，只为争夺本届的“心夏推荐”。当然这其中也包括心夏本人，为此她精心筹备了一种曾经风靡古地球的街边小吃。

【“没想到要拿到我自己的推荐居然这么辛苦啊……”】
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString:
心夏心目中最浪漫化的探险家形象，出自脍炙人口的动作冒险电影系列。心夏逛遍了古旧服装设计店，一件一件地定制出了这身经典装扮。

【“宝藏！到处都是宝藏！嘿嘿~不过比起宝藏，我更喜欢途中遭遇的那些冒险！”】
Description.LocalizedString: The most romanticized explorer image in Xinxia's mind comes from the popular action-adventure movie series. Xinxia visited old clothing design stores and customized this classic outfit piece by piece. ["Treasures! There are treasures everywhere! Hehe~ But compared to the treasures, I prefer the adventures I encountered along the way!"]

Description.SourceString:
“幻梦求真录”历史文化展览在沐春期间连续举办，在卡丘人之中掀起了一股仿古风潮。人们仿照古壁画中仙人的服装制式，设计了一系列典雅、精致、飘逸的服装。

【“怎么样，这套衣服很适合我吧？古代仙人的传说听了这么多，还是第一次能进行模仿和扮演，真有趣啊！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
During the Spring Festival, the "Dreams to Reality" exhibit inspired a trend among the Strinovians, leading to a collection of refined garments modeled after ancient mural attire.

"How do I look? It suits me, right? I've heard so many legends about ancient celestial beings, and it's my first time dressing up like one. This is so much fun!"

Description.SourceString:
心夏在希达半岛行动时特制的作战服。其设计采用了当地韵味十足的传统工艺，不仅能适用于全地形的作战环境，还能抵御当地特殊气候带来的问题。

【“发掘真相的路千难万险，但勇敢的心会带我们找到希望。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Kokona's custom combat suit designed for her mission on the Seeda Peninsula. It incorporates traditional local craftsmanship, making it suitable for all terrains and resistant to the area's unique climate challenges.

"The path to uncovering the truth is fraught with obstacles, but a brave heart will lead us to hope."

Description.SourceString:
手工部部长心夏同学亲自动手改良的制服款式，简洁的外表下增加了大量的工具组件，足以收纳下她所有的灵感和巧思。

【“总是学习也太没劲了，说好咯，今天课后我们一起创造些有趣的发明吧。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Redesigned by Handicraft Club President Kokona, this uniform's sleek design includes plenty of tool storage for her creative ideas.

"Studying all the time is dull. Let's make some cool inventions together after class today."

Description.SourceString: 心夏休假时穿着的居家服饰。即使身在家中，她也时刻准备着下一场冒险。
Description.LocalizedString: Kokona's loungewear during her vacation. Even at home, she is always ready for the next adventure.

TskinDescription.SourceString:
“不管是外出冒险也好，睡大觉也好，难得的休息日当然要做自己最喜欢的事！”
结束了一天的忙碌，心夏换上舒适的居家服，慵懒地躺在家中。

身边是成堆的纸箱，和五花八门的道具。
其中既有来不及整理的过往回忆，也有前往新的未知天地的必备工具。
“哎呀，你也别光看着了，快来给我出点主意。”
TskinDescription.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString:
隶属于机动天使队的超弦少女，行动代号：夏日黄，是O.P.A.L为了对抗危害世界的崩溃兽，秘密组建的特殊战队“机动天使”中的一员，用爱与和平的力量前来维护正义。
——热门动画《机动天使GEN》官方设定集
Description.LocalizedString:
A Superstring Agent codenamed Summer Yellow. She is a member of the Mecha Angels, a secret special unit of P.U.S assembled to combat The Collapse and save the world with the power of love and peace.

—Official Artbook of the popular anime "Mecha Angel GEN"

TskinDescription.SourceString:
【“心夏前辈！你看你看，这个动画里的角色好像你啊！”
屏幕中播放着机动天使·夏日黄战斗的场景——“红!蓝!这些杂兵就交给我了！别担心，我们不是约好了吗？这场战斗之后，我们一起去吃烤肉吧——”
“欸……是吗？哪里像？可是她说完这句话就被敌方的集火击落了啊……我有这么不靠谱吗？”
“前辈，这你就不懂了吧？这就是夏日黄的魅力所在！不管立下什么FLAG都能安全回归，不愧是“黄金的不死鸟”，安全感满分！”
“嘿嘿，是这样吗？我也想试试说一次这种帅气的台词呢。”
“既然这样，下次艾顿城的漫展心夏前辈要不要COS成夏日黄和我一起去？”
“好像很有趣的样子，那就算我一个吧！”
在那之后，心夏不仅熬夜补完了《机动天使队GEN》，还手工制作了全套的角色道具，出于还原考虑这套装备甚至有着实战能力。在那之后，机动天使的粉丝们之间一度传出了机动天使其实是真实存在的都市传说。
“哎呀，我还想着既然要做就做的彻底一点。不过，好像有点过头了？”】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
“Look, Kokona-senpai! That character in the anime looks just like you!”
The screen shows a battle scene with Mecha Angel - Summer Yellow. “Red! Blue! Leave the grunts to me! Don’t worry; we agreed, right? Let’s have a barbecue after this battle—”
“Eh... Really? How so? But she got shot down right after saying that... Am I really that unreliable?”
“But that’s what makes Summer Yellow so amazing! No matter what she promises, she always returns safely. That’s why she’s called the 'Golden Phoenix'. She’s full of reassurance!”
“Is that so? I'd like to say a cool line like that sometime.”
“In that case, how about cosplaying as Summer Yellow and going to the Arton City Anime Convention with me?”
“Sounds like fun! Count me in!”
After that, Kokona pulled multiple all-nighters to finish watching Mecha Angel GEN, and hand-crafted an entire set of props with actual combat functionality. For a while, an urban legend circulated among fans that the Mecha Angels were actually real.
“Umm... I figured if I was going to do it, I might as well go all out. Maybe I went a bit too far?”

“欸……是吗？哪里像？可是她说完这句话就被敌方的集火击落了啊……我有这么不靠谱吗？”
“前辈，这你就不懂了吧？这就是夏日黄的魅力所在！不管立下什么FLAG都能安全回归，不愧是“黄金的不死鸟”，安全感满分！”
“嘿嘿，是这样吗？我也想试试说一次这种帅气的台词呢。”
“既然这样，下次艾顿城的漫展心夏前辈要不要COS成夏日黄和我一起去？”
“好像很有趣的样子，那就算我一个吧！”
在那之后，心夏不仅熬夜补完了《机动天使队GEN》，还手工制作了全套的角色道具，出于还原考虑这套装备甚至有着实战能力。在那之后，机动天使的粉丝们之间一度传出了机动天使其实是真实存在的都市传说。
“哎呀，我还想着既然要做就做的彻底一点。不过，好像有点过头了？”】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
“Look, Kokona-senpai! That character in the anime looks just like you!”
The screen shows a battle scene with Mecha Angel - Summer Yellow. “Red! Blue! Leave the grunts to me! Don’t worry; we agreed, right? Let’s have a barbecue after this battle—”
“Eh... Really? How so? But she got shot down right after saying that... Am I really that unreliable?”
“But that’s what makes Summer Yellow so amazing! No matter what she promises, she always returns safely. That’s why she’s called the 'Golden Phoenix'. She’s full of reassurance!”
“Is that so? I'd like to say a cool line like that sometime.”
“In that case, how about cosplaying as Summer Yellow and going to the Arton City Anime Convention with me?”
“Sounds like fun! Count me in!”
After that, Kokona pulled multiple all-nighters to finish watching Mecha Angel GEN, and hand-crafted an entire set of props with actual combat functionality. For a while, an urban legend circulated among fans that the Mecha Angels were actually real.
“Umm... I figured if I was going to do it, I might as well go all out. Maybe I went a bit too far?”

Description.SourceString: 由剪刀手尖端科技打造而成的特殊作战服，复杂深奥的设计里汇入了梅瑞狄斯的一生所学。
Description.LocalizedString: A special combat uniform crafted with the cutting-edge technology of The Scissors, incorporating Meredith's lifetime of knowledge into its complex design.

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯的备用作战服。如同石蕊试纸一般的紫色涂装，以身为尺，测量世界的平衡。
Description.LocalizedString: Meredith's spare combat uniform in purple, resembling litmus paper. Using herself as a measure, she gauges the balance of the world.

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯的备用作战服。上面有她熟悉的颜色，也许在她心中曾有另一幅关于未来的蓝图。
Description.LocalizedString: Meredith's spare combat uniform, featuring her familiar colors. Perhaps, deep inside her, there is a blueprint of the future.

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯的备用作战服。令人想起灼热砂尘的灰粽色涂装，阳光越是热烈，阴影也越是浓稠。
Description.LocalizedString: Meredith's spare combat uniform. Its gray-brown color evokes the scorching desert sands, with shadows growing deeper as the sun blazes brighter.

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯的备用作战服。深沉的铜绿色涂装，腐锈的铜绿象征着变化的开始。
Description.LocalizedString: Meredith's spare combat uniform. Its deep verdigris color symbolizes the beginning of change.

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯的备用作战服。与剪刀手相衬的红色涂装，旧日的锈刃将开辟铁之道路。
Description.LocalizedString: Meredith's spare combat uniform in red, matching the color of The Scissors. The rusty blade of yesteryear shall hew an iron path.

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯的备用作战服。如同古树一般的深绿色涂装，长久的沉思之后，古树开出了新芽。
Description.LocalizedString: Meredith's spare combat uniform. Its deep green color resembles ancient trees, blossoming with new buds after a long slumber.

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯的备用作战服。春日嫩芽般的浅绿涂装，新生的希望需要栽培与呵护。
Description.LocalizedString: Meredith's spare combat uniform in light green, resembling the tender buds of spring. A new hope needs nurturing and care.

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞迪斯的备用作战服。柔和的明黄与她相得益彰，真理也许就隐藏在过去的记忆中。
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString: 梅瑞狄斯为进行水域实地调查活动而准备的套装，出没于海浪的掩护下，谨慎地行动。
Description.LocalizedString: An outfit prepared by Meredith for aquatic field research. She moves cautiously under the cover of the waves.

Description.SourceString: 黑与白的大面积混搭，究竟哪一面才是真正的她？梅瑞狄斯就像是这件衣服一样捉摸不定。
Description.LocalizedString: With a striking mix of black and white, which side truly represents her? Meredith is as enigmatic as this outfit.

Description.SourceString: 为梅瑞狄斯定制的特殊服装，棱形核心是她内心决意的体现，尖锐，理性，绝不动摇。
Description.LocalizedString: A special outfit customized for Meredith with a diamond core symbolizing her sharp, rational, and unwavering resolve.

Description.SourceString: 冷艳的紫罗兰绽放于空白的荒野，不为他人，独自绚烂，幽谷独兰，孤芳无需赏。
Description.LocalizedString: The stunning violet blooms in the barren wilderness, not for others, but to shine alone. The beauty of a solitary orchid in a secluded valley needs no admiration.

Description.SourceString: 体现天平这一意象的典雅套装，公正而高洁的裁定者将为世界下达判决。
Description.LocalizedString: An elegant outfit symbolizing scales of justice. A noble adjudicator shall deliver judgments for the world.

Description.SourceString: 为在深夜中保持清醒与敏锐，梅瑞狄斯一直在苦寻一款好用高效的提神饮料——直到她尝试了某家医疗机构的“星芒咖啡”。仅浅尝一口，她便爱上那份石油般的口感，三日不眠不休的功效对她来说亦恰到好处。
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString:
为欧泊工作时，梅瑞狄斯曾亲自带队前往真实荒野区域探索，这套凝聚着冒险精神的服装亦由她本人亲手设计。

【“若因对未知的恐惧而止步于探索边缘，人类的勇气和未来将因此缺失一角。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
While working for P.U.S, Meredith once led a team to explore the True Wilderness. She designed this outfit to embody the spirit of adventure.

“If explorers halt due to the fear of the unknown, it will undermine humanity's courage and future.”

Description.SourceString:
尽管一开始只是出于好奇的尝试，但梅瑞狄斯很快就发现——她很享受在漫画中绘制出自己理想的世界，这成了她不为人知的业余爱好。
但是，即使在漫画的世界里，也同样有着不可调和的矛盾——那就是每一个漫画家都必须与之对抗的，名为截稿日的魔王。

【“对，是我…推迟下次的作战。理由？没什么，只不过是要退治一下魔王。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
What started as a curious experiment quickly became Meredith's secret hobby—drawing her ideal world in manga. But even in the world of manga, there are unavoidable challenges—the relentless deadline that every manga artist must battle.

"Yes, it’s me… pushing back the next mission. Why? Oh, just got a date with the demon king called Deadline."

Description.SourceString:
在普雷顿义演时，梅瑞狄斯为流离失所的孩子表演节目时穿着的服装，尽管表情依旧一板一眼，但这位魔术师依旧受到了孩子们的欢迎。

【“魔术也不过是一种定量的技术罢了。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The outfit Meredith wears while performing for displaced children at a charity event in Preton. Despite her expressionless face, the magician is still adored by the children.

“Magic is but a quantitative technique.”

Description.SourceString:
经过梅瑞狄斯个人改造，考究而专业的咖啡厅工作装。配合精准的钟表器械，咖啡厅的一切动向都在她的观察之下。

【“客人，关于你的事情，我可以近距离观察记录么？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A refined and professional cafe uniform, personally tailored by Meredith. With her precise timepiece, she closely monitors every movement in the cafe.

"Mind if I observe and take notes on you up close?"

Description.SourceString:
梅瑞狄斯参加古文明主题活动时的装扮，以华美古典之风还原了月亮之神的神话造型，既充斥着月亮的温柔，又凸显了着装者猫一般的迷人身姿。

【“神守护着万民安康，而我也在见证着属于我们的繁荣。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Meredith's outfit for the Ancient Civilizations event embodies the mythic allure of the Moon Goddess, blending classical elegance with lunar grace, while highlighting her cat-like charm.

"As the sacred guardian ensures wellness for all, I also witness the prosperity we share."

Description.SourceString:
梅瑞狄斯的乐队演出服，以大胆酷炫地裁剪与设计，表达了梅瑞狄斯对摇滚精神的理解。除了实验台上的严谨肃穆，作为学者的梅瑞狄斯也同样向往着没有约束的自由。

【“摇滚包含着自由与探索的品质，这与科学精神不谋而合。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Meredith puts on this outfit when performing with her band. The bold design reflects her understanding of the spirit of rock n' roll. A composed scholar, Meredith also longs for freedom without restraints.

“Rock n' roll embodies freedom and exploration, aligning perfectly with the spirit of science.”

Description.SourceString:
不知何时出现在地下酒吧的神秘客人，没有人知道她的来意，也没有人知道她携带的秘密。

【“我们真的是第一次见面吗？总觉得就连这个疑问，都曾经被发出过许多次呢。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A mysterious guest has appeared at the underground bar. No one knows what brought her here or what secrets she holds.

"Are you sure we haven't met before? I can't help but feel like I've asked you this exact question many times before."

Description.SourceString:
庆典园游会总设计师梅瑞狄斯参加泳池派对时穿着的服装。面料特殊，不光适用于日常的游泳运动，也可以穿着浮潜。

【“你说得没错，参与庆典的人们，和他们在此感受到的快乐与感动，也是一场完美庆典必不可少的部分。”】
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString:
为了融入霓之城的夜幕，梅瑞狄斯换上了她并不习惯的街头风格。而耳机能够帮她隔绝城市的浮躁与嘈杂，使她保持那一贯的自我。

【“我将指引霓之城的所有人，就像你指引我一样。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
To blend into the nightlife of Neon City, Meredith dons a streetwear outfit she is not accustomed to. Her headphones help her shut out the city's restlessness and noise, allowing her to stay true to herself.

“I shall guide everyone in this city just as you have guided me.”

Description.SourceString: 星绘于星庇所内工作时所着的裙装，其间闪烁的星辰图案象征着星庇所救死扶伤的理念。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia wears this dress while working at Astral Sanctuary. Its twinkling star patterns symbolize Astral Sanctuary's creed of not giving up on any patient.

Description.SourceString: 星绘的备用工作服，略带酸涩的青，增添了少女的魅力。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia's spare work uniform in lime green, accentuating her charm.

Description.SourceString: 星绘的备用工作服，叶片般的裙装掩映间，星辰纹样若隐若现。
Description.LocalizedString: Astierred's spare work uniform. The leaf-like skirt subtly reveals patterns of stars.

Description.SourceString: 星绘的备用工作服，幽蓝的裙装，令少女显得神秘莫测。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia's spare work uniform. The deep blue dress gives her an air of mystery.

Description.SourceString: 星绘的备用工作服，裙裾飘舞，如一朵紫色流云。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia's spare work uniform in purple, flowing like a drifting cloud.

Description.SourceString: 星绘的备用工作服，海蓝色的裙装，映衬出少女的风姿。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia's spare work uniform in navy blue, highlighting her grace.

Description.SourceString: 星绘的备用工作服，温暖的橙黄色，让人想起灯火与美食。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia's spare work uniform in warm orange, reminiscent of lights and delicacies.

Description.SourceString: 星绘的备用工作服，庄重的紫红色，最适合出现在盛大的晚宴上。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia's spare work uniform in elegant purple, suitable for formal occasions.

Description.SourceString: 星绘的备用工作服，淡雅的紫色，也是北极星的另一种别称。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia's spare work uniform in soft purple. The Purple Star - another name for the North Star.

Description.SourceString: 糖果为裙装点缀了虹色，少女的气息也随之绽放于夏日。下一颗彩虹糖，会是什么颜色呢？
Description.LocalizedString: The candies adorn the dress with rainbow colors as her aura blooms in the summer. What color will the next rainbow candy be?

Description.SourceString: 缀以金纹的深青裙装，在星绘身上就如同华丽的公主。小心，不要随便对她伸出手，荆棘可是带刺的。
Description.LocalizedString: Donning this gilded teal dress, Celestia looks like a gorgeous princess. Be careful not to touch her, for the thorns are prickly.

Description.SourceString: 典雅的紫色裙装，衬托出星绘高雅神秘的气质。这套衣裙与星绘很相称，但背后的故事，她却从来闭口不谈。
Description.LocalizedString: The elegant purple dress accentuates Celestia's mysterious elegance. It suits her well, but she never speaks of the story behind it.

Description.SourceString: 摇曳的碧裙清新亮眼，甜美得宛如夏日凉风。与身着这套衣裙的星绘对谈，也如喝下一杯甜美的冷饮一般，沁人心脾。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia's eye-catching green dress sways in the wind, as sweet and cool as a summer breeze. Talking to her while she's wearing it feels refreshing and delightful, like enjoying a cold, sweet drink.

Description.SourceString: 夏夜，月升，风吹草动，蜻蜓扑腾。在她身边，闭上眼睛，享受这宁静一刻。
Description.LocalizedString: The moon rises on a summer night, the grass sways in the wind, and dragonflies flutter. Close your eyes and enjoy this tranquil moment by her side.

Description.SourceString:
梦幻般的裙装，华丽绽于衣袂的繁复之中，究其灵感，似乎源于某广为流传的童话故事。

【“梦的世界里有什么呢？”
“皇后、茶会、好看的衣服？”
“除此之外呢？”
“还有引航的白兔前……啊不，是白兔先生！”
人们总以为少女的梦境流连于童话，只有无端的华美和幻想。
不过也有着关于某些真实人物的记忆呢。】
Description.LocalizedString:
A dreamy dress with a lavish, intricate design, seemingly drawn from a well-known fairy tale.

"What lies in the dream world?"
"A queen, tea parties, and lovely dresses?"
"What else?"
"And the guiding Mr. Rabbit!"

People often assume her dreams dwell solely in fairy tales, filled with whimsical beauty. Yet, they also hold memories of real people.

Description.SourceString:
天使般纯然的护士服，温柔的外表下，却隐隐透露着危险的意味。

【“您的病情还没稳定下来，可千万不要随意走动呀。”
“不如在这里多住一阵子吧？”
“……永远留在这里怎么样？”

在那个仅属于她的故事里，她将永远守护着你，直到时间的尽头。】
Description.LocalizedString:
The nurse's uniform is angelically pure, but beneath its gentle appearance, there lurks danger.

"You haven't fully recovered. Please stay in bed."
"Perhaps I should stay a bit longer."
"...How about forever?"

In her story, she will protect you until the end of time.

Description.SourceString:
星绘为田园旅行特别设计的服装，以“园艺师”为主题，色调是清新的绿色。住进充满田园气息的小屋，嗅闻清新凉爽的空气，身边有好友相伴，或许，这就是返璞归真的快乐吧。

【“久等了，今天你独自照看牧场，真是辛苦啦。让我把这只向日葵送给你，再给你介绍个新朋友。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Designed for pastoral journeys, Celestia's outfit embodies a gardener theme with soothing green tones. Breathing the fresh air with friends in a quaint country cottage brings back simple but true happiness.

"Sorry to keep you waiting. You've been taking care of the ranch on your own today, that must have been tough. Here's a sunflower for you, and I'd like to introduce you to a new friend."

Description.SourceString:
星绘在太空体验馆所穿着的实验性穿梭服，该服装使用多种聚合物材料构成，在保温性和抗冲击方面都有着不错的水平。但曾经是为了保证星际航行中使用的装备，而现如今只能存放在场馆之中供人体验。

【“在迈上太空之前，我们却走向了维度的迷雾。——展品说明标签上，是这么说的呢。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
An experimental spacesuit Celestia wears at the Space Center. Made from various polymer materials, the outfit offers excellent insulation and impact resistance. Originally designed for interstellar travel, it now resides in the museum for visitors to experience.

“Before stepping into space, we ventured into the fog of dimensions. That's what the tag says.”

Description.SourceString:
星绘为了参加游乐园活动精心搭配的装束，清爽的牛仔外套给人以别样的心动感觉，悄悄拉下圆帽的时候又能遮住她那双害羞的眼睛……

【“还有很多项目没有体验呢，那个……可以不用看着我也可以的哦？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The outfit Celestia prepared for the amusement park event. The refreshing denim jacket exudes a sense of excitement while the hat perfectly covers her shy eyes when pulled down...

“There are still many attractions left... um, you don't have to look at me, you know?”

Description.SourceString:
星绘为了准备流星雨的夜间观测而准备的服装，稍显较厚质地的服装能够在夜晚也提供充足的保温，不失可爱的版型设计更是衬托出了星空下的她那一份质朴的美丽。

【“流星的美丽在于它划过黑夜所带来的一丝光亮，而我们就像这流星雨，划过夜空，遇见彼此。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Celestia's outfit for meteor shower nights combines warmth with style. Its thicker material keeps her cozy while the cute design highlights her simple beauty under the starry sky.

“The beauty of a meteor lies in its fleeting light. Like meteors, we cross the night sky and find each other.”

Description.SourceString:
以花朵为主题，加入了盘扣、流苏等要素的传统服饰。
白色代表纯洁，紫色象征忧悯，黄色寓意温婉，就像她本人一样，无私的疗愈着这个世界的一切。

【沉默，也是一种无言的爱。】
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString:
星绘主持沐春前夜星庇所活动时的装束，精心装扮的裙裳掩盖不了她想同最重要的人一同夜游的心情。

【“前辈，团圆夜活动之后，可以和我看看夜景吗？就我们两个人。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Celestia's outfit for hosting the Spring Blessings Eve event at Astral Sanctuary. The decorated skirt can't conceal her wish to explore the night with the one she holds most dear.

"Would you go for a walk with me after the event? Just the two of us."

Description.SourceString: 星绘休憩时经常穿着的居家服，只有她最熟悉的人才有机会一睹其容。
Description.LocalizedString: Celestia only puts on this loungewear when resting. Only those closest to her have a chance to see her in this outfit.

TskinDescription.SourceString:
“前辈有好好注视过这片星空吗？”
“据说，每个人都有一颗属于自己的星辰，它在宇宙里孤独地等待着，希望有一个人能与它遥遥相望。”
“如果有一天，前辈遥望天际的时候发现了一抹别样的光芒，那大概就是前辈的星辰正在眨眼吧。”
“前辈问我的星辰在哪里？那……那是秘密。”

少女从未曾停止对夜空的追寻。
在无数个与星光对视的夜晚里，少女等待着那颗星星，自浩瀚渺茫的星海里捕捉属于自己的光芒。
有一天，星星眨眼了。
整片夜空都改变了颜色。
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
"Have you ever truly looked at the starry sky?"
"I heard there is a unique star for everyone, waiting alone in the universe, hoping someone would gaze at it."
"If one day you see an unusual light in the sky, that's probably your star winking at you."
"Where is my star? Well... that's a secret."

The girl never stops chasing the night sky.
Through countless nights under the stars, she patiently waits for that one star in the vast galaxy to reveal itself.
One day, the star winks at her.
And the entire night sky changes its colors.

Description.SourceString: 劲装风格的骑士服，优雅华美的外形下，隐藏着利剑般的凛然气质。
Description.LocalizedString: A knight-style outfit. Beneath its elegant and splendid appearance lies a sharp and bold spirit.

TskinDescription.SourceString:
【瑰丽的宫廷剑士向着远方眺望。
战场哭嚎，血涂四方。
装饰蔷薇的利剑刺穿了敌人的心脏。
蔷薇染血，逆影怒放。
思念如风，飘向远方。
“花期为君，死又何妨？”】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
The royal swordswoman, enchanting as a rose, gazes into the distance.
She sees nothing but carnage and rivers of blood.
The rose-decorated sword pierces an enemy's heart.
The rose is dyed in blood's hue; shadows cast wide their pall.
Her mind, like the breeze, wanders far, unconfined by any wall.
“For you alone, the flowers unveil their bloom; should they fade, what sorrow calls?”

Description.SourceString: 劲装风格的骑士服，优雅华美的外形下，隐藏着利剑般的凛然气质。
Description.LocalizedString: A knight-style outfit. Beneath its elegant and splendid appearance lies a sharp and bold spirit.

Description.SourceString: 令最为青睐的服装搭配，舒适简约，实用可靠，沉稳中流溢着一位战士最坚定的意志。
Description.LocalizedString: Reiichi's favorite outfit. It is comfortable, simple, practical, and reliable, exuding the firm will of a warrior.

Description.SourceString:
令常用作战服的备用款，功能完备，战斗能力与原款相当。

【不要停止抗争，也不要失去希望。】
Description.LocalizedString:
Reiichi's backup combat suit. Fully functional, it matches the combat capabilities of the original.

“Do not stop fighting. Do not despair.”

Description.SourceString:
在荧火汇聚成皓月之前，
我未曾见过真正的月色。
Description.LocalizedString:
Before the fireflies gathered into a bright moon,
I had never truly seen the moonlight.

Description.SourceString: 令常用作战服的备用款，神秘紫色的内衬，包裹着他重重的心事。
Description.LocalizedString: Reiichi's backup combat suit. The mysterious purple lining conceals his many burdens.

Description.SourceString: 令常用作战服的备用款，不论在怎样的黑暗中，他都怀抱着一丝希望的余晖。
Description.LocalizedString: Reiichi's backup combat suit. Even in total darkness, he harbors a glimmer of hope.

Description.SourceString: 令常用作战服的备用款，幽蓝的色调，仿佛一支满怀愁绪的歌。
Description.LocalizedString: Reiichi's backup combat suit. The deep blue hue sings a song of sorrow.

Description.SourceString: 令常用作战服的备用款，军绿的色彩，代表着他对自己的戒律。
Description.LocalizedString: Reiichi's backup combat suit. The army green symbolizes his discipline.

Description.SourceString: 令常用作战服的备用款，浅青色的内衬，象征着他心中依旧保有的明净天空。
Description.LocalizedString: Reiichi's backup combat suit. The light blue lining symbolizes the clear sky in his heart.

Description.SourceString: 令常用作战服的备用款，黯淡的绿，就像他那几近枯萎，却依旧不灭的希望。
Description.LocalizedString: Reiichi's backup combat suit. The dim green symbolizes his nearly withered yet undying hope.

Description.SourceString: 令常用作战服的的备用款，鲜明如晨光的内衬与深色的外套形成强烈反差，他很少穿着。
Description.LocalizedString: A variant of Reiichi's combat uniform. The bright shirt contrasts sharply with the dark coat. He rarely wears it.

Description.SourceString: 雪白简练的衣衫，让令看上去像个年轻的医生。但实际上，他只精通战场上的紧急处理。一切，都是为了胜利。
Description.LocalizedString: In his crisp white attire, Reiichi looks like a young doctor. But in reality, he's only skilled in battlefield emergency care.

Description.SourceString: 浅蓝的牛仔服，充满着活力与激情。与之相对的，是令冷漠的面容。在冰山一般的外表之下，能量正汹涌澎湃着。
Description.LocalizedString: The light blue denim jacket is full of vitality and passion, creating a sharp contrast with Reiichi's indifferent expression. Beneath his cold demeanor, powerful energy surges.

Description.SourceString: 身为狙击手的令也曾参与正面战场，身着丛林风格装扮，勇敢而又无情。在任务时刻到来前，他永远能够保持耐心。
Description.LocalizedString: As a sniper, Reiichi has also participated in frontal assaults. Dressed in jungle-style attire, he is brave and ruthless, always managing to remain patient until the mission starts.

Description.SourceString: 这套服装饰以交叉的刀剑和神秘的触须，就如同古代海盗的船长服。令从不惧怕深海的诅咒，因为，他自己早已诅咒了自己。
Description.LocalizedString: This outfit, adorned with crossed swords, resembles an ancient pirate captain's attire. Reiichi does not fear the curse of the sea, for he has long cursed himself.

Description.SourceString: 与令的冷漠印象相反，绘制着熊熊烈火的服装。即使是最为冰冷的工具，也需要热力来驱动。
Description.LocalizedString: In sharp contrast to Reiichi's indifferent demeanor, this outfit features patterns of raging flames. Even the coldest of tools need to be driven by heat.

Description.SourceString:
令在执行窃听任务时穿着的服装。
融入环境是特工的一环，哪怕是在咖啡厅，亦是如此。

【“今日会降下一些……不一样的雨。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Reiichi's outfit for eavesdropping missions.
Blending in is part of being a spy, even in a café.

"Today, there will be... a different kind of rain."

Description.SourceString:
令在海滨度假时，为自己准备的水下装束。尽管以功能性为主，却也有许多花哨的小饰物。或许，他的小心思比表面上要多得多。

【“呼……哪怕是海中，也有那么多美丽的珊瑚啊。”
潜水结束，从海中浮上的令，露出了一抹浅浅的微笑。
平时那样冷漠的他，看上去发自内心地享受着这次海滨之旅。
“别那么紧张嘛，平时的我，其实还挺好相处的。”
总觉得，你看到了令极少向人展露出的一面。】
Description.LocalizedString:
Reiichi's diving gear for his seaside vacation is mainly practical but adorned with a few stylish trinkets. It hints that there's more to him beneath the surface.

"Wow... Even underwater, the corals are stunning."
As Reiichi surfaces from his dive, a subtle smile graces his face. The typically aloof demeanor is replaced by genuine enjoyment of the beach escape.
"Relax. I'm actually quite easygoing."
You feel like you have seen a rare side of Reiichi.

Description.SourceString:
为驾驭实验性的高能电磁武器而设计的特殊作战服，根据令的作战经验，着重强化了绝缘防护能力。
无言的狙击手驾驭着澎湃能量抵达战场——

【“小心。漏电。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A special combat suit designed for experimental high-energy electromagnetic weapons, with enhanced insulation based on Reiichi's combat experience.
The silent sniper enters the battlefield, channeling intense energy.

“Careful. You might get a shock.”

Description.SourceString:
令根据旧时代的宇航服定制的私人服装，虽然一部分如实进行了还原，但是为了面对随时突如其来的任务，还是改造成了方便战斗的样式。如果没有争斗也许他也会选择登上宇宙的道路，将自己的奇思妙想挥洒在浩瀚的星空之中吧。

【“气压正常，温度正常……嗯，可惜要是能还原推进装置就好了。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Reiichi's custom-made outfit is inspired by old-era spacesuits, with some parts faithfully recreated. However, it has been modified for combat readiness in case of emergencies. If not for the conflicts, Reiichi might have pursued a path to the stars, unleashing his creativity across the vast cosmos.

“Pressure is normal, temperature is normal… Hmm, too bad I couldn't replicate the propulsion system.”

Description.SourceString:
令用于潜入黑市的特殊装备，强调了东方神韵的神秘感和个人特色，身上的吊坠是令用废石打磨而成的，并非真品的古玩，但也能以假乱真。

【“呵……真是好眼光，这可是尖子货啊。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Reiichi’s special gear for infiltrating the black market emphasizes the mystical allure of Eastern charm and his personal style. The pendant he wears is made from polished scrap, not a genuine antique, but convincing enough to pass as one.

“Heh... You've got a good eye. This is top-notch stuff.”

Description.SourceString:
乡村生活可不止有田野和牧场，一定也少不了一位水电家装样样精通的修理达人。房屋漏水？电器短路？不管要修理的是什么，总之找他就对了。

【“什么？你说要修理的不是电器，是欧泊的治安小队？好吧，也没问题。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
There is more to country life than just fields and farms. You need a skilled handyman who is a jack of all trades. Leaky roofs? Short-circuiting appliances? Whatever needs fixing, he has got you covered.

“What? You need me to take care of the P.U.S security squad instead of appliances? Very well. Leave it to me”

Description.SourceString:
令参加西洋棋表演赛时的服装，软呢帽的配饰以及超宽的翻领使造型在优雅之中增添了几分闲适。平光镜的存在修饰了脸型，再加上染色的头发，如果不是熟人的话，一定不会认出自己吧？

【“教过你多少次了，后翼弃兵的目的是为了保障中央棋盘的安全，不要在这种时候太过在意一枚‘兵’的生死。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Reiichi's outfit for chess exhibition matches. The fedora and the extra wide lapel add a touch of leisure to the elegance, while the plain glasses provide a unique impression. Together with the dyed hair, one would not recognize him if not a close acquaintance.

“How many times have I told you? The whole point of the Queen's Gambit is to ensure the safety of the central board. Now isn't the time to sweat over a single pawn.”

Description.SourceString: 白墨执行任务时所着的佣兵服，强调实战的同时融入了街头元素，利落洒脱，自由无羁。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo wears this mercenary outfit on missions. It combines practicality with streetwear style—sleek, carefree, and unfettered.

Description.SourceString: 白墨的备用佣兵服，像是个还未成熟的大男孩，正准备开始一场快乐的野餐。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo's spare mercenary outfit makes him look like a young boy about to enjoy a picnic.

Description.SourceString: 白墨的备用佣兵服，湖蓝的衣着潇洒俊逸，代表着他奔放的心。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo's spare mercenary outfit in elegant lake blue reflects his unrestrained spirit.

Description.SourceString: 白墨的备用佣兵服，尽管不羁，却也不失浪漫与雅致。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo's spare mercenary outfit, bold yet romantic and elegant.

Description.SourceString: 白墨的备用佣兵服，如他童年梦中，那片广袤的绿野。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo's spare mercenary outfit, resembling the vast green fields in his childhood dreams.

Description.SourceString: 白墨的备用佣兵服，如秋日之下，随自由之风起舞的落叶。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo's spare mercenary outfit, resembling the autumn leaves that dance in the wind of freedom.

Description.SourceString: 白墨的备用佣兵服，他曾搏击浪涛，也曾潜入海底。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo's spare mercenary gear. He's battled waves and plunged into ocean depths.

Description.SourceString: 白墨的备用佣兵服，沙海之中，自由之声将扬起新的风暴。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo's spare mercenary outfit. In the sea of sand, the voice of freedom will stir a new storm.

Description.SourceString: 饰以双鱼和竹叶纹样的料理人服装，让人想起了寿司的香气。对白墨来说，唯有自由……与美食不可辜负。
Description.LocalizedString: A chef's outfit featuring patterns of fish and bamboo leaves, reminiscent of the aroma of sushi. To Bai Mo, freedom and delicacies are the two most important things in life.

Description.SourceString: 印有可乐图案的卫衣款战斗服，与白墨的气质十分契合。身穿这件战斗服的白墨，也如同被摇晃过的可乐一般，充满了激情与跃动的活力。
Description.LocalizedString: A combat hoodie with a cola print, perfectly matching Bai Mo's vibe. Wearing this outfit, Bai Mo bursts with energy and passion, just like a shaken can of cola.

Description.SourceString: 宇航服样式的战斗服，不仅体现出白墨特立独行的性格，更有种充满幻想的优雅感。
Description.LocalizedString: A combat uniform in the style of a spacesuit, not only reflecting Bai Mo's unique personality but also possessing an elegant sense of fantasy.

Description.SourceString: 黑绿间杂，赛车手款式的战斗服，在白墨身上显得倜傥不群。速度与激情，正是白墨喜欢的词句。
Description.LocalizedString: A black and green racing-style combat uniform makes Bai Mo look dashing and unique. Speed and passion perfectly describe him.

Description.SourceString: 有着清爽的蓝白色调的休闲服装。坐着躺椅，听着海风，来上一杯清凉的椰子水，悠闲享受度假时光。
Description.LocalizedString: A casual outfit in refreshing blue and white. Relax on a beach chair, sip a cool glass of coconut water, and enjoy your vacation with the sea breeze.

Description.SourceString: 白墨的咖啡师装扮，据说他曾以这身打扮悄悄在乌尔比诺某家咖啡厅工作过半个月。
Description.LocalizedString: Bai Mo's barista outfit is rumored to be from when he secretly worked at a cafe in Urbino for half a month.

Description.SourceString:
白墨亲手设计的面包师制服。这套服装版型前卫，内衬舒适，只是，近来的他，却没什么机会穿上这套衣服。

【“嗨，你看，这款蓝莓奶酥面包色泽金黄，松软绵密，吃起来酸甜可口，是我亲自烘焙的哦。”
白墨曾悄悄潜入旗下的一家面包店内，作为普通的面包师辛劳了好几天。
看到人们微笑着品尝他烘焙的面包时，他的心中不禁油然而生一股喜悦之情。
至今，那段时光仍是他最美好的回忆之一。】
Description.LocalizedString:
A baker's uniform designed by Bai Mo, featuring an avant-garde design and comfortable lining. However, he has rarely had the chance to put it on.

【“Look. This blueberry milk bread is golden on the outside with a soft and fluffy texture and a sweet and sour taste. I baked it myself. ”
Bai Mo once worked undercover in one of his bakeries for several days.
Seeing people enjoy the bread he has baked fills his heart with joy.
To this day, that remains one of his fondest memories.】

Description.SourceString:
传闻，有一位不定期出现在整修铺里，技术高超的青年。无论什么样的车辆故障他都能搞定，无论怎样老旧的赛车，只要经他的手修理调整，车辆性能都会得到提升。人人都称赞他的修理技术，不过很少过问他的身份。这正是他想要的效果。

“看看，我修的如何？还没有我这把扳手搞定不了的。”
“不过，你这辆车的零件磨损也太严重了。我说，你得珍惜你的伙计啊。”
“…好像在别的地方见过我？这个嘛，这座城市这么大，谁知道是在哪呢？你就别在意了。”
Description.LocalizedString:
Rumor has it that there is a highly skilled young man who shows up in the auto shop from time to time. No matter what the malfunction is or the age of a race car, as long as he repairs and tunes it, the vehicle's performance will be enhanced. Everyone praises his repair skills, but few inquire about his identity - this is exactly what he aims to achieve.

"Check out the repair. There's nothing my wrench can't fix."
"However, the parts are severely worn. You gotta take care of your car, buddy."
"Feel like you've seen me before? Well, it's a large city. Perhaps you have; perhaps you haven't. Don't overthink it."

Description.SourceString:
近未来风格的运动装，色彩鲜明，款式时尚。白墨在这套服装上，加入了不少独属于自己的小设计。

“呀，被你发现了！你也是来带我回去的吗？”
明明已被逼到穷途末路，白墨的脸上，却挂上了一抹狡黠的微笑。
“我可不是在偷懒，乌尔比诺需要一位自由的领袖。把我关在办公室里，可是最大的浪费。”
在你被他的演讲吸引注意的同时，他纵身一跃，用纯熟的街头跑酷技巧逃出了你的视野范围。
Description.LocalizedString:
A futuristic sports outfit with bright colors and a sleek design. Bai Mo has infused it with his own unique touches.

"Oh, you've found me! Are you here to take me back as well?"
Although cornered, Bai Mo still bears a cunning smile.
"I'm not slacking off. The leader of Urbino must be free. Locking me in an office would be a huge waste."
As you're drawn in by his words, he leaps away, skillfully escaping your view with expert parkour.

Description.SourceString:
运用了过去的草原民族服装元素进行设计，融合了白墨的个人巧思和创想。
以天为盖，以地为席，苍茫天地，四海为家——这样自由的生活正可谓白墨所追求的理想。

【“天高云阔，任我遨游，再没有比这更自由的感觉了！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Inspired by traditional prairie attire, this design showcases Bai Mo's unique creativity and vision. Bai Mo's ideal life embodies boundless freedom and natural harmony.

"With the endless sky above, I roam freely. There's nothing more liberating!"

Description.SourceString:
《怪盗英雄》电影的改装款夜行衣，硬朗修身的设计很符合白墨对于美观、舒适的追求。只是，在加入了定制绷带和荧光眼镜后，闪亮的效果与其设计初衷相距甚远。

【镜子前的白墨正对自己的品味赞叹不已，可紧接着发生的事情却让他终 生 难 忘——“嗯，偶尔cos一下夜行侠也不错。欸——别抓着我啊，我可不是小偷！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A modified stealth suit inspired by the movie "Phantom Thief," with a sleek, fitted design that matches Bai Mo's taste for style and comfort. However, the added custom bandages and neon glasses kind of defeat the purpose.

Standing in front of a mirror, Bai Mo marvels at his style, but what happens next is unforgettable - “Hmm, cosplaying as the Phantom Thief once in a while isn't half bad. Hey! Let me go! I'm not a thief!”

Description.SourceString:
白氏集团特别定制的演出礼服，穿上这身衣服的白墨举手投足都散发着沉稳庄重的气质，如果他不开口说话的话……

【“我的音准还不错吧！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A performance suit customized by the Bai Group. Donning this outfit, Bai Mo exudes a calm and dignified aura; that is until he speaks...

【“My pitch isn't half bad, right?”】

Description.SourceString:
在电玩比赛报名现场出现的神秘男子，尽管他用墨镜、帽子、假胡子做了三重伪装，但是围观的群众还是辨认出了他的真实身份。

【“我只是一名普通玩家，主办方什么的简直是天方夜谭！我为电玩比赛出过力，我要当选手！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A mysterious man appeared at the arcade registration, trying to conceal his identity with sunglasses, a hat, and a fake mustache. Yet, the crowd still recognized him.

"I'm just an ordinary player. Being the organizer is a tall tale! I've contributed to the arcade scene; now I want to be a contestant!"

Description.SourceString:
当白墨换上西服，收敛笑意时，属于乌尔比诺少主的那份沉稳才显现出来。

【“你是贵客，当然要享受最好的服务。至于我们要聊的事……不着急，慢慢来。”】
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString:
在人头攒动的盟主选举现场，伴随着一阵强劲的音乐，一道绿色闪电驰骋而来。不同于往日浪迹街头的街舞小子、涂鸦大王，今日的白墨盛装出席，风度翩翩，但是他的嘴角依旧挂着那抹向往自由意志的标志性微笑。

【“如果我能连任的话，就一个月休三十天吧！”
面对台上台下浪潮般的欢呼与掌声，白墨不由得惊叹道。
“哟呵，大伙比我还要热情啊~”】
Description.LocalizedString:
At the bustling alliance leader election, a streak of green lightning zips through to energetic music. Unlike his usual street dancer and graffiti king style, Bai Mo is dressed to the nines, looking dapper, yet his iconic smile still exudes a longing for freedom.

"If I am re-elected, we'll have 30 days of vacation each month!"
Bai Mo is taken aback by the tidal wave of cheers and applause.
"Wow, you're all more excited than I am!"

Description.SourceString:
作为主办方代表，这位年轻的乌尔比诺盟主在比赛开幕式上一经亮相，就吸引了媒体的长枪短炮。他的打扮，似乎在致敬某个经典角色？

【“啊，抱歉，比起赛车，骑着摩托车炫酷登场果然更适合我啊！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
As the host, the youthful Urbino leader stole the spotlight at the opening ceremony, drawing cameras with his striking look—a tribute, perhaps, to an iconic character.

"Ah, sorry! Turns out, a cool motorcycle entrance suits me better than racing!"

Description.SourceString:
白墨作为乌尔比诺联盟的盟主，代言了联盟旗下娱乐集团发明的数字化直播设备，并缔造了一夜之间获得百万粉丝的直播界奇迹！如今，他的身份又多了一个——引领潮流的顶流主播。很显然，他对这个身份适应良好，并随时准备在这个世界掀起新的风暴。

【看看我，看看我，我不有趣吗？呃……吞噬注意力的怪兽，他们是这么形容我的？只要进入一次我的直播间，就会像上瘾一样根本离不开？】
【这怎么会是冒犯呢？这分明是最好的夸奖啊！！！】
Description.LocalizedString:
As the leader of the Urbino Alliance, Bai Mo has endorsed the digital streaming equipment invented by the alliance's entertainment group, creating a miracle in the streaming world by gaining a million followers overnight! He has now added another title to his name - the trend-setting top-tier streamer. Clearly, he has adapted well to this identity and is ready to stir up another storm in the world.

“Look at me, look at me! Am I not interesting? Uh... a monster that devours attention? Is that how they describe me? Once you open my stream, you'll never close it, like an addiction?”
“How is that an insult? That's the best compliment I've ever received!!!”

TskinDescription.SourceString:
【近日，乌尔比诺商业联盟中心大厦外的巨大屏幕时常轮播一则广告：一个模糊到只能依稀辨认出是男性的身影，穿行在卡拉彼丘各个城市。他的身体是变换的数字信号，有时出现在热闹的集市内，有时穿梭在夜晚的高楼间，有时又直接像素化，出现在某个热门的游戏里。广告最后结束在一串数字里：1220。人们驻足仰望，猜测这串数字究竟有什么含义。

这是一个粉丝数为0的直播间，却在最热门时间段出现在最热门直播网站的首页。直播间内空空荡荡，只有一把转椅，甚至连直播间的号码都被马赛克覆盖。怀着好奇心涌入的观众越来越多，马赛克也越来越稀薄，最终完全消失，定格在熟悉的1220。直播间热闹起来后，一把吉他出现在空中，随后是手握吉他的白墨。

直播间沸腾了，而属于顶流主播白墨的时代，才刚刚拉开序幕。】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
The screen outside Urbino Business Alliance has been playing an advertisement: A blurry figure, just barely recognizable as male, moves through various Strinovan cities. His body is composed of shifting digital signals, appearing in bustling marketplaces, weaving through skyscrapers at night, and, at times, pixelating directly into a popular game. The ad ends with a mysterious: 1220. Passers-by stop and gaze at the screen, speculating on the meaning of the number.

A livestream with zero followers mysteriously appears on the homepage of the most popular streaming site at peak hours. The footage is completely empty, with only a spinning chair, and even the stream ID is censored with mosaic pixels. As curious viewers flood the stream, the mosaic gradually fades before completely disappearing, revealing the familiar number 1220. As the stream gains traction, a guitar appears mid-air, followed by Bai Mo holding it.

The livestream explodes in popularity, marking the beginning of Bai Mo's era as a top-tier streamer.

Description.SourceString: 驱逐!驱逐！驱逐!
Description.LocalizedString: Expel! Expel! Expel!

Description.SourceString: 加拉蒂亚进行魔术表演时的服装，低调而华丽。为了避免被人认出，她还会搭配上宽檐礼帽——尽管，这似乎让她更加夺目了。
Description.LocalizedString: Galatea's magic show outfit is understatedly elegant. To avoid being recognized, she puts on a wide-brimmed hat—ironically making her even more eye-catching.

Description.SourceString: 加拉蒂亚众多魔术礼装中的一件，据说配色灵感来源于孔雀的眼睛。
Description.LocalizedString: One of Galatea's many magic costumes. It is said that the color scheme was inspired by the colors of a peacock's eye.

Description.SourceString: 加拉蒂亚众多魔术礼装中的一件，据说配色灵感来源于青翠的竹林。
Description.LocalizedString: One of Galatea's many magic costumes. Its color scheme is rumored to have been inspired by a lush bamboo forest.

Description.SourceString: 加拉蒂亚众多魔术礼装中的一件，据说配色灵感来源于某次“上流社会”的晚宴。
Description.LocalizedString: One of Galatea's many magic costumes. Its color scheme is rumored to have been inspired by an upper-class banquet.

Description.SourceString: 加拉蒂亚众多魔术礼装中的一件，据说配色灵感来源于快要下雪的阴沉傍晚。
Description.LocalizedString: One of Galatea's many magic costumes. It is said that the color scheme was inspired by a gloomy dusk with impending snow.

Description.SourceString: 加拉蒂亚众多魔术礼装中的一件，据说配色灵感来源于果园里成熟的葡萄。
Description.LocalizedString: One of Galatea's many magic costumes. It is said that the color scheme was inspired by ripe grapes in the vineyard.

Description.SourceString: 加拉蒂亚众多魔术礼装中的一件，据说配色灵感来源于上好品质的蓝绿猫眼石。
Description.LocalizedString: One of Galatea's many magic costumes. It is said that the color scheme was inspired by top-grade cymophane.

Description.SourceString: 加拉蒂亚众多魔术礼装中的一件，据说配色灵感来源于她地窖里珍藏的红酒。
Description.LocalizedString: One of Galatea's many magic costumes. The color scheme is said to be inspired by the fine red wine stored in her cellar.

Description.SourceString:
虽然比起咖啡，加拉蒂亚更喜欢“浓烈”一点的饮料，但不得不说，这种咖啡豆的风味确实独特。
“唔……下次加点儿酒，做成酒渍希爪吧。”
Description.LocalizedString:
Though Galatea prefers "stronger" drinks over coffee, she admits that these coffee beans do have a unique flavor.

"Hmm... Next time, I'll add some liquor and make spiked Sidra coffee."

Description.SourceString: 传闻这件礼服的设计灵感来源于某次加拉蒂亚仰望星空半小时，也有人说是她出席白芸博物馆珠宝展后灵感迸发。对此，加拉蒂亚不置可否：“星星与宝石，本来就很相像嘛。”
Description.LocalizedString:
It's rumored that Galatea designed this dress after gazing at the night sky for half an hour. Others say inspiration struck after she visited the Cloudscape Gallery's jewelry exhibition. Galatea neither confirms nor denies these rumors.


"Stars and gemstones are quite similar, aren't they?"

Description.SourceString: 擅长使用扑克牌道具的魔术师，在其他牌类游戏中也技艺超群，这是理所当然的事情吧？可不要因为一直输给加拉蒂亚，就恼羞成怒哦。
Description.LocalizedString: As a magician with a knack for card tricks, she's unmatched in any card game—a true master indeed. Just remember, losing to Galatea is all part of the fun!

Description.SourceString:
尽管很习惯长时间处于喧闹的环境中，但偶尔，加拉蒂亚也会前往宁静的山野林间休憩。
“听了太多人类的声音，偶尔，也想听听自然在说些什么嘛。”
Description.LocalizedString:
Although Galatea is used to being in noisy environments, she occasionally retreats to the peaceful mountains and forests.

“I listen to human voices all the time. Sometimes, I just want to hear what nature has to say.”

Description.SourceString:
是谁将旧时的城堡带入黑暗，谁又将这份黑暗当作了新的舞台？
“魔术师可不止会放鸽子，蝙蝠同样具有演出效果。”
Description.LocalizedString:
Who cast the old castle into darkness, and who turned that darkness into a new stage?

“A magician knows more tricks than making doves appear out of thin air. Bats could also do the trick.”

Description.SourceString:
急促的倒计时钟声鸣响着，本届星光魔术师的获奖者即将揭晓……伴随一抹颓靡的浅笑，无数道绯红倩影登台亮相，宛如归巢的红鹮鸟，而所有的灯光也汇集到了她们的身上。

【“今夜的荣誉属于我，以及更多的我。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
As the countdown ticks down, the winner of this year's Stardust Magician is about to be announced. With a fleeting, languid smile, countless crimson silhouettes take the stage, resembling scarlet ibises returning to their roost, as every spotlight gathers upon them.

"Tonight's glory belongs to me, and many more of me."

Description.SourceString:
乌尔比诺旗下音乐厂牌签约DJ加拉蒂亚在本次泳池派对活动中穿着的服装。据现场观众回忆，玩到兴起时，加拉蒂亚曾把自己头戴的宽檐草帽抛向泳池中，还引起了游客的争抢，不过到晚上，那顶帽子又奇迹般回到了加拉蒂亚头上。

【“泳池派对，我玩得很开心呢。下次再叫我吧？这次不需要演出费。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
At the recent pool party, Galatea, a DJ under the Urbino music label, turned heads with her stylish ensemble. Attendees recall the moment she tossed her wide-brimmed straw hat into the pool, sparking a friendly scramble among partygoers. Somehow, by evening, the hat had made a surprising return to her head.




"I had a total blast! Count me in for the next one!"

Description.SourceString:
一道刺眼的光芒，一霎模糊的幻象，没有人能形容孔雀羽的美丽，也没有人能逃脱欺诈师的诡计。

【“开屏魔术！这也是骗你的哦。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A blinding light, a fleeting illusion—no one can truly capture the beauty of a peacock's feather, nor escape the trickery of the deceiver.

"Just another trick on you."

Description.SourceString:
虽然身着短款格纹打歌服，但加拉蒂亚特意选择了一顶毛茸茸的贝雷帽，为优雅成熟的形象增添了几分柔和与纯真。

【“这顶帽子……是不是很像雪落在了我的头上？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Galatea pairs a fluffy beret with her plaid stage outfit, adding a hint of softness and innocence to her elegant, mature image.

"This hat... doesn't it look just like snow settling on my head?"

Description.SourceString:
“幻梦求真录”历史文化展览在沐春期间连续举办，在卡丘人之中掀起了一股仿古风潮。人们仿照古壁画中仙人的服装制式，设计了一系列典雅、精致、飘逸的服装。

【“哎呀呀，总觉得换上这套衣服，就要羽化登仙了呢。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
During the Spring Festival, the "Dreams to Reality" exhibit inspired a trend among the Strinovians, leading to a collection of refined garments modeled after ancient mural attire.

"Oh my, it feels like I'm about to ascend to the heavens in this outfit."

Description.SourceString:
加拉蒂亚作为乌尔比诺代表选手，参加耐力赛时的装束。每当赛车驶过固定位置，摄像机总能捕捉到她一闪而过的侧颜，和嘴角一抹从容的笑意。

【“呼~这种把一切都甩在身后的感觉，真是喜欢呢。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
As Urbino's chosen racer, Galatea wears this striking outfit. Each time she blazes by, the cameras catch her confident profile and the hint of a relaxed smile.

"Nothing beats the thrill of leaving everyone behind."

Description.SourceString:
蝉联多届电玩比赛冠军、如风一样来去自由的加拉蒂亚选手，在观众瞩目之下递交了今年比赛的报名表，她参加报名仪式的时尚装扮也迅速在年轻人中流行起来。

【“看好了哦，我只表演一次的弹幕魔术！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Galatea, the multi-time eSports champion known for her swift, dynamic moves, has entered this year's tournament to much anticipation. Her trendy outfit at the registration event has quickly become a hit among young fans.

"Watch closely—my bullet magic is a one-time show!"

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特经常穿着于身的研究服，兜帽上两只可爱的小熊耳朵，透露出稚子般的童真。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's favorite lab coat. The pair of teddy ears on the hood reveals her childlike innocence.

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特的备用研究服，被一抹靓丽的紫映衬着，亭亭如纤细的薰衣草。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's spare lab coat. The vibrant purple makes her as graceful as a slender lavender.

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特的备用研究服，藏在她冰冷的外表之下的，是一颗火热的内心。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's spare lab coat. Beneath her cold exterior, there lies a fiery heart.

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特的备用研究服，柑橘色清新淡雅，正衬得她愈发甜美动人。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's spare lab coat. The soft orange makes her look even sweeter and more charming.

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特的备用研究服，萌芽般的绿意，宛如阳光下新生的幼芽。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's spare lab coat. The budding green resembles fresh sprouts under the sunlight.

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特的备用研究服，灿灿的黄色让人感到内心的温暖。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's spare lab coat. The bright yellow brings a warm feeling to the heart.

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特的备用研究服，深埋冰雪之中的，是那动人的暖意。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's spare lab coat. The touching warmth is buried deep in the snow.

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特的备用研究服，盛夏树木的繁叶也难以掩盖少女的心思。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's spare lab coat. The lush summer leaves can hardly conceal the girl's thoughts.

Description.SourceString: 在神秘的紫色映衬下，以蛛网，蝙蝠与古堡为饰的服装。即使这是个童话故事，伊薇特也不一定是其中的公主哦。
Description.LocalizedString: An outfit in mysterious purple, featuring images of spider webs, bats, and an ancient castle. Even though this is a fairy tale, Yvette might not necessarily be the princess.

Description.SourceString: 以四叶草为装饰，清新可爱的研究服。希望、信心、爱、还有幸运。伊薇特祝愿这些美好的东西，永伴你的身边。
Description.LocalizedString: A cute lab coat decorated with clovers. Hope, faith, love, and fortune —Yvette wishes all these good things to be with you.

Description.SourceString: 浅粉色的研究服，以樱花、雪山与明月为装饰意象。伊薇特仿佛立于风中，飘落的花瓣正落在她的肩上。
Description.LocalizedString: A pale pink lab coat adorned with cherry blossoms, snowy mountains, and a bright moon. Yvette seems to stand in the wind, with petals gently falling on her shoulders.

Description.SourceString: 白蓝相间的简洁外套下，浅橙色的长袜让人想起甜甜的汽水。内向且羞涩的伊薇特，偶尔，也会展露出这样甜美的一面。
Description.LocalizedString: Under the simple white and blue coat, Yvette's orange socks evoke the sweetness of soda. Though usually introverted and shy, Yvette occasionally shows this sweet side.

Description.SourceString: 慵懒的午后，最适合来上一杯见习咖啡师伊薇特亲手冲制的浓郁摩卡。
Description.LocalizedString: A lazy afternoon is best suited for a cup of rich mocha brewed by apprentice barista Yvette.

Description.SourceString: 为了研究不同信件对人们情绪波动的影响，伊薇特换上信使的服装，穿梭于各家各户感受人们的心情。只是，面对着她自己想要送出信件的对象时，伊薇特注意到自己的心跳骤然加快。
Description.LocalizedString: In order to study the impact of letters on people's emotions, Yvette dons the courier's outfit, delivering letters to different households to feel their sentiments. However, when looking at the person she wants to send a letter to, Yvette notices her heartbeat suddenly accelerating.

Description.SourceString:
伊薇特野外出行时喜着的服装，朴素不加点缀的风格映射着她纯洁的内心。当然，偶尔她也会有属于自己的少女心。

【“诶？你是说，你想和我们一起吃午餐吗？可是，我找不到菲了……”
“那，要不然，这一次就我们俩，偷偷一起吃吧……”
伊薇特是真的找不到菲吗？还是说……
这个问题，只有等日后，她亲自来为你解答了。】
Description.LocalizedString:
Yvette's outfit for outdoor excursions. The simple, unembellished style reflects her pure heart. Of course, she occasionally shows her cute, girlish side.

【“Eh? You would like to have lunch with us? But I can't find Fay...”
“How about you and I have lunch in secret this time...”
Can Yvette really not find Fay? Or...
She is the only one who can give you the answer to that question.】

Description.SourceString:
伊薇特的海滨装束，少女的青春活力和清凉感，让人眼前一亮，看上去就像是一只可爱的熊猫。

【“熊猫……是不会出现在海边的。”
理所当然，伊薇特不可能不知道这一点。
那么，她为何会选择这套衣装呢？你不禁有些好奇
“……这样的话，我就是独一无二的了。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Yvette's beach outfit radiates youthful energy and a refreshing vibe, grabbing everyone's attention, much like a cute panda.

"Pandas are bears too," Yvette giggles, touching her ears. "At least Fay won’t feel alone at the summer music fest with a fellow bear around."

Description.SourceString:
伊薇特在咖啡店实习时穿着的服装。
为了改善自己的交流能力，伊薇特在引航者的建议下接受了这份工作。
尽管伊薇特是抱着服务的态度来的，却经常被顾客反向投喂，令她感到些许不解。

【“客人，这样的话，菲也会很困扰的……”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Yvette's outfit for her internship at the café. On the navigator's advice, she took the job to improve her communication skills. Although Yvette tried to serve the customers, she was baffled to discover that they were more interested in serving her.

“Fay wouldn't know what to make of this either, sir...”

Description.SourceString:
在研究遇到瓶颈时，伊薇特偶尔会溜出实验室，没人知道她去了哪，只知道在她回来时会带着一脸满足继续埋头工作。
如果你在奶茶店的街角遇到了熊，请不要惊慌，只要假装没看到她就行，她会在补充完糖分后自行离开。

【“糖分，很重要……糖果屋，似乎很有人气……稍微，有点兴趣。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
When Yvette encounters bottlenecks in her research, she would occasionally slip out of the lab. No one knows where she goes, only that she would return with a satisfied look and continue to immerse in her work.
If you spot a bear in a milk tea shop, don't panic. Just act like you didn't see her, and she'll leave once she's had her sugar fix.

"Sugar is really important... That candy shop seems popular... Hmmm..."

Description.SourceString:
伊薇特受邀参加荒野冬日特别活动时所穿的服装，保暖的绒装充满贴身感与弹力，足以支持一切冬季的户外活动，是伊薇特十分喜欢的冬装。

【“冷吗？我觉得……一点也不会冷。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Yvette's outfit for the Wilderness Winter Challenge. The elastic warm fleece is suitable for all winter outdoor activities, making it her favorite winter clothing.

“Are you cold? I don't feel cold at all.”

Description.SourceString:
伊薇特在参加苹安节活动时穿着的服装，一改平时的冷色调风格，并尽力还原了某个童话中的造型，只是相比故事里的主人公，她可不会束手就擒的。

【“我的苹安果……你可以收下吗？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The outfit Yvette wears to the Safety Day event. A sharp contrast to her usual cool-toned clothing, this outfit replicates a look from a fairy tale. However, unlike the protagonist in the story, she would not surrender without a fight.

【“Would you accept... my safety apple?”】

Description.SourceString:
伊薇特受邀参加乌尔比诺的文艺汇演时所穿的服装，轻盈而凸显着古文明的山水诗意，虽然伊薇特的舞步还有几分稚嫩和不熟练，但这并不妨碍她成为汇演时的焦点。

【“一曲霓裳舞，只因夜思君。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Yvette's outfit for the Urbino talent show. The light dress evokes poetic scenery of ancient civilizations. Yvette may not be the best dancer, but that didn't stop her from becoming the star of the show.

“I dance, for I miss you day and night.”

Description.SourceString:
护目镜、战术头盔、迷彩作战服……因为引航者的邀请，伊薇特认真备齐了一名战术分析官应有的全套装备。虽然战场不同于研究所，但伊薇特充分发挥自己强大的分析与研究能力，为前方作战的同伴保驾护航。

【“战、战术分析官伊薇特前来报道……”
害羞柔弱的声音微微颤抖着。
“那个……引航者，伊薇特收集到的作战数据，帮到大家了吗？”
那双温柔熟悉的双手轻轻摩挲着她的额头。
紧张羞红的少女渐渐地平复了自己的心情，来自引航者的安抚似乎是一种最为神奇的特效药，无论面对什么，她都能变得勇敢而坚定。】
Description.LocalizedString:
Goggles, tactical helmet, combat suit... At the Navigator's invitation, Yvette thoroughly equipped herself with all the gear a tactical analyst needs. Although the battlefield is nothing like the lab, Yvette utilizes her analytical and research skills to support her allies on the front lines.

"T-Tactical Analyst Yvette reporting for duty..."
Her shy, soft voice trembles slightly.
"Um... Navigator, did the combat data I collected help anyone?”
Those gentle, familiar hands softly brush her forehead.
The nervous, blushing girl gradually calms down. The Navigator's reassurance seems to be a magical remedy, empowering her to face anything with courage and resolve.

Description.SourceString:
伊薇特为了深入研究崩溃症，在临床试验时所穿的制服。对一个严谨的科研工作者来说，只要对方的心脏还在跳动，就证明没有什么大问题。

【“心跳节奏，60……78……110，状态良好，你可以出院了。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Worn by Yvette during clinical trials to research Collapse Syndrome, this uniform symbolizes the dedication of a meticulous scientist. For her, a solid heartbeat is always a positive sign.

"Heartbeat at 60... 78... 110. All looks good. You're ready for discharge."

Description.SourceString: 小熊居家服、电子设备和冰饮料构成了伊薇特的宅家三件套。这套居家服有着柔软的熊耳朵，每当缺乏灵感时，伊薇特总会下意识地摸摸它。
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TskinDescription.SourceString:
“也不是真的，不喜欢出门……”
女孩不好意思地把小熊兜帽的帽檐往下扯了扯：“只是外面人太多了，很吵闹……家里，有菲，有毛绒毯子，还有喝不完的冰饮料……”
“伊薇特觉得，呆在家里也很开心……你，你会同意我的看法吧？”
TskinDescription.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特参加欧泊舞会的服装，虽然有点不好意思在众人面前打扮得如此隆重，但偶尔能展现出不一样的一面，也很好。
Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's dress for the P.U.S ball. While she still feels shy about dressing so formally, she finds it nice to show a different side of herself every now and then.

TskinDescription.SourceString:
虽然以高级研究员的身份加入了欧泊，但伊薇特内向、社恐的性格一直难以改变。每每从人群中穿过，她总是拉低帽檐，尽量降低自己的存在感。殊不知，这也为她打上了“怪人”的标签。
“比起人类，那家伙看上去更像是个动物吧？只靠直觉活着的样子真是可悲呢。”
“和谁都不说话，只会工作的怪胎，简直就像提线木偶一样。”
“和她制造的那只机器熊一样，都是没有灵魂的东西啦。”

没关系，只要捂住耳朵，快点离开，就听不到那些话了……伊薇特加快了脚步。下一秒，两个熟悉的身影出现在她面前。
“小熊，你怎么又不看通讯消息！穿什么去参加下个月的欧泊舞会，你想好了吗？需要建议吗？”米雪儿顶着火力大喵满脸兴奋。
“啊？舞会……”伊薇特脸上露出为难的表情：“是要穿礼服的那种吗……伊薇特没有可以穿去舞会的衣服……而且，有点不好意思……”
“没关系，现在时间还很充裕，无论是买衣服，还是亲手做一件，都完全来得及哦！”心夏自信满满地握拳：“最重要的是，伊薇特必须在舞会上盛大登场，给那些只会在背后编排你的人看看——”
心夏没有降低音量，不如说，她本来就是要说给某些人听的：“伊薇特不是怪人，她有朋友，而且朋友们也很喜欢她！”
“米雪儿、心夏前辈……”伊薇特怔怔地看着两人：“明白了……！伊薇特给菲做过衣服，给自己做，应该也不难……关于服装造型的建议，就拜托两位了……！”

单片的雪花，往往还没有落地便已融化。但当它们凝结在一起，便有了迎风飞舞的勇气。
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
Even though Yvette joined P.U.S as a senior researcher, her shy and socially anxious personality is hard to shake. She often pulls up her hoodie to blend into the background, unwittingly earning the "weirdo" label.
"Isn't she more like an animal than a human? Living on instinct is just sad."
"A workaholic freak, like a puppet."
"Just like her soulless robot bear."

It's okay, just block it all out and move away quickly, and those hurtful words won't reach you… Yvette quickened her step. Suddenly, two familiar faces appeared in front of her.
"Yvette, why aren't you checking your messages? Have you thought about what to wear for the P.U.S ball next month? Need any advice?" Michele asked with a cheerful grin.
"The ball? Uh..." Yvette’s face flushed with unease. "Is it the kind where you wear fancy dresses? I... don't really have anything suitable, and honestly, it feels a bit embarrassing..."
"No worries! We've got plenty of time. Whether you want to buy a dress or make one, we can help you out!" Kokona declared confidently, pumping her fist. "The most important thing is for you to shine at the ball and prove those gossipers wrong."
Kokona’s voice rang out for all to hear, purposefully: "Yvette isn’t some weirdo. She has lots of friends who really love her!"
"Michele, Kokona..." Yvette said softly, touched by their support. "Okay...! I've sewn for Fay before, so I should be able to create something for myself. I'll count on you both for fashion tips!"

A single snowflake may melt before touching the ground, but together they gain the courage to dance in the wind.

Description.SourceString: 伊薇特参加欧泊舞会的服装，虽然有点不好意思在众人面前打扮得如此隆重，但偶尔能展现出不一样的一面，也很好。

“啊？舞会……”伊薇特脸上露出为难的表情：“是要穿礼服的那种吗……伊薇特没有可以穿去舞会的衣服……而且，有点不好意思……”
“没关系，现在时间还很充裕，无论是买衣服，还是亲手做一件，都完全来得及哦！”心夏自信满满地握拳：“最重要的是，伊薇特必须在舞会上盛大登场，给那些只会在背后编排你的人看看——”
心夏没有降低音量，不如说，她本来就是要说给某些人听的：“伊薇特不是怪人，她有朋友，而且朋友们也很喜欢她！”
“米雪儿、心夏前辈……”伊薇特怔怔地看着两人：“明白了……！伊薇特给菲做过衣服，给自己做，应该也不难……关于服装造型的建议，就拜托两位了……！”

单片的雪花，往往还没有落地便已融化。但当它们凝结在一起，便有了迎风飞舞的勇气。
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
Even though Yvette joined P.U.S as a senior researcher, her shy and socially anxious personality is hard to shake. She often pulls up her hoodie to blend into the background, unwittingly earning the "weirdo" label.
"Isn't she more like an animal than a human? Living on instinct is just sad."
"A workaholic freak, like a puppet."
"Just like her soulless robot bear."

It's okay, just block it all out and move away quickly, and those hurtful words won't reach you… Yvette quickened her step. Suddenly, two familiar faces appeared in front of her.
"Yvette, why aren't you checking your messages? Have you thought about what to wear for the P.U.S ball next month? Need any advice?" Michele asked with a cheerful grin.
"The ball? Uh..." Yvette’s face flushed with unease. "Is it the kind where you wear fancy dresses? I... don't really have anything suitable, and honestly, it feels a bit embarrassing..."
"No worries! We've got plenty of time. Whether you want to buy a dress or make one, we can help you out!" Kokona declared confidently, pumping her fist. "The most important thing is for you to shine at the ball and prove those gossipers wrong."
Kokona’s voice rang out for all to hear, purposefully: "Yvette isn’t some weirdo. She has lots of friends who really love her!"
"Michele, Kokona..." Yvette said softly, touched by their support. "Okay...! I've sewn for Fay before, so I should be able to create something for myself. I'll count on you both for fashion tips!"

A single snowflake may melt before touching the ground, but together they gain the courage to dance in the wind.

Description.LocalizedString: Yvette's dress for the P.U.S ball. While she still feels shy about dressing so formally, she finds it nice to show a different side of herself every now and then.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的演出服，兼具美丽与实用。纤细修长的衣摆，宛如夜莺舒展羽翼。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's performance outfit is both beautiful and practical. Its slender, flowing design resembles a nightingale spreading its wings.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的备用演出服，青涩的渐变色如同花瓣般娇嫩。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's spare performance costume in cyan, resembling delicate petals.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的备用演出服，耀眼的橙黄，如同她心中跃动的热情火焰。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's spare performance outfit, in dazzling orange and yellow, mirrors the passionate flames in her heart.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的备用演出服，紫罗兰的闪耀，在她身上尽情绽放。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's spare performance costume in brilliant violet, blooming to its fullest.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的备用演出服，夜如何其？夜未央，鸾声将将。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's spare performance costume. The nightingale's song lingers in the endless night.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的备用演出服，凤尾芭蕉，龙吟细细。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's spare performance costume, as elegant as a phoenix and as subtle as a dragon's whisper.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的备用演出服，鎏金的色彩与偶像的光芒交相辉映。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's spare performance costume. The gilded color reflects the idol's radiance.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的备用演出服，鲜嫩的绿意贸然生长。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's spare performance costume in green, symbolizing growth.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美的备用演出服。舞台上，她如那颗名为月亮的星星一般明亮。
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString: 香奈美特制的一套演出服，有着魅惑中略带危险的氛围。也许，就在今晚，她会在你的梦中出现哦。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's special performance costume, with a charming yet slightly dangerous aura. Perhaps she will appear in your dreams tonight.

Description.SourceString: 这套演出服上，描绘着星环的图样。裙上星光的舞动，正如香奈美华丽的舞姿。
Description.LocalizedString: A performance costume featuring a shooting star pattern. The fluttering starlight resembles Kanami's gorgeous dance moves.

Description.SourceString: 清淡素雅的薄荷色衣装，衬托得香奈美更加清纯动人。夏日热情的演唱会，也因为她的装扮，多了几分清凉。
Description.LocalizedString: This elegant mint-colored outfit makes Kanami appear even more pure and charming, adding a touch of coolness to the passionate summer concert.

Description.SourceString: 可爱的粉色包装纸，包裹着甜蜜的浅青色糖果。香奈美的这套演出服，将她的甜美魅力衬托得淋漓尽致。
Description.LocalizedString: The cute pink wrapping paper encases the sweet cyan candies. Kanami's outfit perfectly highlights her charming sweetness.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美参加咖啡品牌推广活动时的演出服装，服装设计特别参考了咖啡的拉花工艺，只为向粉丝们传递咖啡般温暖的心意。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's promotional outfit for the coffee brand was inspired by latte art, designed to convey a warm, coffee-like sentiment to her fans.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美演出服的特别版，以灿烂阳光照耀下的向阳葵田为灵感设计，展现出香奈美无限的热情。
Description.LocalizedString: Kanami's special edition costume is inspired by a sunflower field under the bright sun, showcasing Kanami's boundless ardor.

Description.SourceString: 香奈美演出服的特别版，以青葱的幸运四叶草为灵感设计，只为将好运通过歌声传递给粉丝们。
Description.LocalizedString: A special version of Kanami's performance outfit, inspired by the fresh green of four-leaf clovers, designed to pass good luck to fans through her songs.

Description.SourceString:
只有在正式场合，香奈美才会换上这套华丽庄重的礼服。少女的浪漫与成熟女性的优雅完美结合，彰显出她独有的熠熠华彩。

【“我就是穿着这套衣服，第一次作为偶像登台的。”
“那时的感情，我一辈子都不会忘记。”
“为了再度邂逅那样的感动，我必须要肩负起所有人的期望才行。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Kanami wears this stunning gown only for formal events. It blends youthful romance with mature elegance, highlighting her unique brilliance.

"This is the dress I wore when I first took the stage as an idol. I will never forget how I felt back then. I must meet everyone's expectations to feel that kind of emotion again."

Description.SourceString:
作为香奈美新曲宣传的活动企划而设计的服装。
经过多次改修，在偶像的距离感与女仆的亲近感间达成了完美平衡，而她喜欢这件服装的理由，似乎另有原因……

【“香奈美是属于大家的偶像，但是……此时此刻，请让我成为专属于您的女仆。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
An outfit designed for the promotional event of Kanami's new song.
After several modifications, it strikes a perfect balance between the distance of an idol and the closeness of a maid. However, she seems to have another reason for liking this outfit...

"Kanami is everyone's idol, but... for now, let me provide you with an exclusive maid café experience."

Description.SourceString:
香奈美在享受假日时选择的休闲服装。当沐浴在聚光灯下时，很少有人意识到——舞台上无敌的偶像，在褪去光芒后也只是一个平凡的邻家少女，她也有权力享受属于少女的青涩时光。
只是，身为偶像的职业素养似乎让她总是敏锐地感觉着周围的目光。这让香奈美感到一丝紧张与悸动，不由得抓紧了身边人的手臂。

【咚、咚、咚……香奈美的心跳，你听到了吗？】
Description.LocalizedString:
Kanami's choice of loungewear while on vacation. Few realize that beneath the spotlight, the invincible idol is just an ordinary girl offstage, entitled to enjoy her youthful moments.
Still, as an idol, she's always aware of others' gazes, feeling slightly nervous and thrilled, holding onto the person next to her.

"Ba-dum... Can you hear Kanami's heartbeat?"

Description.SourceString:
香奈美作为偶像参加乡间录制节目时所穿的服装，轻快的短裤背带裙上即使沾染了些许泥土，也不会影响偶像可爱的风格，即便是剧组结束了工作，香奈美依旧保留了这套服装。

【“看着作物一天天成长，内心也有被充实的感觉呢。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The outfit Kanami wore when she performed in a rural concert. The mud on her light dungarees skirt does not ruin her cute style. Kanami chose to keep this outfit after the show ended.

“There's something so satisfying about watching the crops grow day by day.”

Description.SourceString:
香奈美受邀参加金树乐章音乐会时所穿的服装，非常注重表现自身魅力，以及与指挥家的搭配感，不知道是否是有意为之……？

【“想和你，做最美的梦。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The outfit Kanami wears when invited to the Golden Tree Symphony concert. It highlights her charm and coordination with the conductor. Intentional, perhaps?

"I would like to dream the most beautiful dream with you."

Description.SourceString:
香奈美受邀前往月桂大厅演出的魔术表演礼服，同时借鉴了燕尾服与芭蕾舞裙的元素。优雅与浪漫是香奈美永恒的追求，而裙摆华丽的装饰品中似乎暗藏玄机。

【“呼…香奈美，你可以的。一定要把我们的东西拿回来！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Kanami wore this dress, which borrows elements from the tuxedo and the tutu, for the magic show that she was invited to perform in at Laurel Hall. Elegance and romance are Kanami's eternal pursuits, and there seems to be a hidden mystery in the gorgeous ornaments on the skirt.

"Phew... You can do it, Kanami. We must get our things back!"

Description.SourceString:
香奈美出演神话戏剧所穿的戏服，以古希腊女神为原型，衣白如浪花，裙摆若鱼尾，月桂叶编制的金色花冠更显高洁与神圣。

【“我会一直为你祈祷的。”
少女倾注了全部的情感与心意念完了最后一句台词。
“果然把你当作排练对象，很快就能……啊，没什么。”
少女似乎想说出什么，却又在一阵慌乱中欲言又止。】
Description.LocalizedString:
Kanami's costume for her mythological play. Inspired by a Greek goddess, the dress resembles pure ocean waves with a skirt shaped like a mermaid's tail, topped with a golden laurel for a touch of sanctity.

"I will pray for you. Always." The girl pours all her emotions and thoughts into the final line. "Rehearsing with you really does... Uh, never mind."

The girl hesitates for a moment before deciding not to finish her sentence.

Description.SourceString:
在超银河主题演唱会上，香奈美个人搭配的演出服。跨越星河的歌声与战斗曾是某个科幻系列的永恒主题，而香奈美仿佛化身为唱响银河的歌姬，诠释着自己的理解。

【“你可曾记得银河与爱呢？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Kanami's performance outfit for the Galactic Concert. Songs and battles across the galaxy were once the eternal theme of a sci-fi series. With this outfit, Kanami transforms into a diva singing across the galaxy, expressing her unique interpretation.

"Do you remember the galaxy and love?"

Description.SourceString:
少女坠入深海，她的裙纱与长发随波绽放，点点萤光将大海点亮。在海的怀抱中，她度过了一段梦想已久的难忘旅途。

【“这段冒险，要是没有终点就好了。”】
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString:
作为偶像，在沐春节到来之际，当然要换上符合气氛的新衣裳！今年的设计主题是“剪纸”，香奈美特地选择了鸟儿的图案，配合上复古的款式设计，在城中掀起了一股新的时尚风潮。

【“都说时尚是个轮回，香奈美也觉得，稍加改造、配上饰品，这套衣服穿去打歌也不违和呢！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
As an idol, Kanami embraces the arrival of Spring Blessing by wearing outfits that capture the festive mood! This year's design theme is "Paper-Cutting," and she chose a bird pattern with a vintage flair, setting off a new fashion trend in the city.

"Fashion always comes back around. With a few modifications and some accessories, Kanami believes this outfit is stage-ready for performances too!"

Description.SourceString: 香奈美假日里穿着的可爱裙装。卸下舞台多重装扮的香奈美，穿上了一身淡黄色的连衣裙，或许只有在你的身边，她的心境才能变得轻盈自在。
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

TskinDescription.SourceString:
【作为偶像的香奈美平时很喜欢研究妆容造型。
无论是清透的白开水裸妆，还是精致的舞台亮片妆，香奈美都能很好地完成。任何彩妆产品一旦到了她的手里，就能被巧妙地运用起来。
此时此刻，做好妆造的香奈美用唇膏在镜子上画了一个可爱的标记。
“引航者，你会不会染上香奈美的颜色呢？”。】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
【As an idol, Kanami enjoys spending time on makeup and styles.
Whether it's a natural look or an elegant stage look, Kanami excels at putting them on, skillfully applying any makeup products.
As Kanami finishes her makeup, she draws a cute mark on the mirror with her lipstick.
“Navigator, will you be colored by my hues?”】

Description.SourceString:
在世界濒临记忆崩溃之际，香奈美抵达了偶像这一身份的巅峰与尽头，成为了音乐的化身，灵魂的容器。
她于万众瞩目之下唱起了一首承载着希望的歌，用自己的力量改写了故事的结局。

【“我会化作永恒的世纪之歌！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
As the world faces the brink of collapse, Kanami reaches the pinnacle and end of her journey as an idol, becoming the embodiment of music and a vessel for souls. With all eyes on her, she sings a song of hope, using her power to rewrite the ending.

"I will become the eternal song of the century!"

TskinDescription.SourceString:
【晶源感染危机爆发后，异形怪物占领了一些重要城市，以科莫斯为中心的防护体系濒临崩溃，整个区域陷入了一种极其不稳定的逆弦化状态。
根据卡丘紧急事务署的深入调查，异形怪物的暴力趋势与情绪的波动呈正相关，某些特殊的声音能对其产生有效的抑制作用。香奈美在得知这件事情的第一时间，迅速赶往了世界的至高点位，因为只有在那里，歌声才能传遍整个空间。
此时此刻，香奈美以天穹为舞台，以歌声为武器，拉开了演出的序幕。只见一阵又一阵的声波贯穿了异形怪物的身体，异化的谵惘晶粹也纷纷碎裂成了漫天璀璨的“钻石”，至此，歌姬完成了她的使命。】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
After the outbreak crisis, alien creatures overrun several key cities. The defense system centered around Komos is on the verge of collapse, plunging the region into an extremely unstable state of reverstring.
According to the Bureau of Anomalous Affairs, there's a direct link between the creatures' aggression and their emotional fluctuations. Certain special sounds can effectively suppress them. Upon learning this, Kanami races to the highest point in the world, the only place where her voice can reach every corner.
Kanami takes the sky as her stage and her voice as her weapon, launching into her grand performance. Waves of sound pierce the alien creatures, shattering their mutated crystals of delirium into dazzling "diamonds" that sparkle across the sky. With this, the diva completes her mission.
