Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的作战服，整体设计简洁舒适，蝴蝶元素作为点睛之笔，更能衬托穿着者的优雅魅力。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's combat uniform features a simple and comfortable design. Butterfly elements add a final touch, highlighting the wearer's elegant charm.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的备用制服。蝶翼伴随着微风舞动，忽近忽远，难以琢磨。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's spare uniform. Butterfly wings flutter with the breeze, teasingly drifting near and far, always just out of reach.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的备用制服。如同一汪深沉的湖水，看不透，望不穿。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's spare uniform, resembling an unfathomable deep lake.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的备用制服。忍耐过寒冬的嫩芽，等待着初春的绽放。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's spare uniform. The bud that has endured the cold winter waits for spring to bloom.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的备用制服。蝴蝶收起翅膀，隐藏在朽叶之中。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's spare uniform. The butterfly folds its wings, hiding among the decayed leaves.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的备用制服。谎言与真相不分彼此，一同融入了紫色的夜中。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's spare uniform. Lies and truth become indistinguishable, blending into the purple night.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的备用制服。失去温度的黯淡火焰，如同幻影，冰冷地燃烧。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's spare uniform. A dim flame that has lost its warmth burns coldly like a phantom.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的个人定制服装，咖啡、牛奶与鲜奶油的灵感碰撞。游走在咖啡与牛奶的边界之间，亦是一种危险的游戏。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's custom outfit, inspired by coffee, milk, and cream. Walking the line between coffee and milk is a dangerous game.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅在欧泊的授勋式上穿着的正式服装。她不会就此止步，她将继续向上攀登，直到没有人可以为她授勋。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's formal attire for the P.U.S award ceremony. She won't stop there; she'll keep climbing until no one is left to bestow honors upon her.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的个人定制服装。薰衣草一般的淡紫色衣裙，散发着似有若无的香气，在蝴蝶的舞姿中沉入梦乡。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's custom lavender outfit. Its subtle fragrance lulls you to sleep amidst the dance of butterflies.

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的个人定制服装。毒蛇潜伏在潭水之中，等待着前来饮水的猎物。不，她不是毒蛇，她是守在一旁等待结果的猎人。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's custom outfit. The viper lurks in the water, waiting for its thirsty prey. No, she is not the viper; she is the hunter waiting next to it.

Description.SourceString: 当温暖的第一缕春风吹来，树木的枝头披上新绿，万物开始复苏。在这个时候，去踏踏青、晒晒太阳正好，毕竟蝴蝶可不会错过如此美好的春日。
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅的个人定制服装。芬芳而又幽静的季节已悄然到来，蛹虫难抑心中的躁意，化生翅脉，翩入幽色绽放的春天。
Description.LocalizedString: Flavia's custom outfit. The fragrant and serene season has quietly arrived. The restless cocoon transforms, spreading its wings and dancing into the shadowy bloom of spring.

Description.SourceString: 水母在海中漂浮，就像蝴蝶在空中飞舞。传闻芙拉薇娅在游览水族馆后，以此为灵感设计的衣服。
Description.LocalizedString: Jellyfish drift through the sea like butterflies flutter through the air. It's rumored that Flavia designed this outfit, inspired by a visit to the aquarium.

Description.SourceString:
抱着试探的想法向芙拉薇娅发出了一同出游的邀约，没想到对方却爽快地答应了。

【“嗯？怎么了？天气这么好，蝴蝶也想晒晒太阳嘛。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
I invited Flavia to go out with me. To my surprise, she actually said yes.

"Hmm? What's the matter? The weather's lovely, and even butterflies need their sunshine."

Description.SourceString:
结合蝴蝶元素而设计的女仆工作服，华贵而优雅。芙拉薇娅以这身迷人的着装神秘地现身咖啡厅，原因不得而知。她似乎掌握了关于某个人的重要情报。

【“想要换取情报么，客人？呵呵，先赢了我再说喔~”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A luxurious and elegant maid outfit inspired by butterflies. Donning this enhancing outfit, Flavia mysteriously appears in the café. She seems to have obtained important intel about someone.

“Are you looking to trade information? You'll have to defeat me first.”

Description.SourceString:
像孔雀羽毛般华丽的裙装，穿在芙拉薇娅的身上，轻易就能吸引整个舞池的目光。

【“不要紧张，把一切交给我——作为舞伴，我会照顾好你的。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Wearing a beautiful dress, Flavia is as glamorous as a dazzling peacock, capturing the spotlight on the dance floor.

"Don't stress about it. Leave it to me. As your dance partner, I'll take care of you."

Description.SourceString:
热情而大方的餐厅制服，芙拉薇娅用以潜伏于某家街边小馆中。迎着美丽的日落，享受着伊比利亚式的醇香与美味，芙拉薇娅和客人们一同沉浸在这种浪漫的情调中。

【“在日落之处，我为他们奉上醇香与火腿。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Wearing a vibrant and elegant restaurant uniform, Flavia seamlessly blends into a street-side café. Under the beautiful sunset, Flavia and the guests savor Iberian delicacies as much as the romantic atmosphere.

"At sunset, I serve them jamón ibérico and all its rich flavors."

Description.SourceString:
芙拉薇娅参加泳池派对时穿着的服装。清凉又优雅的设计勾勒出她完美的身材，蝴蝶装饰物则采用了特殊的贝壳纹材料，在阳光的照耀下能折射出特殊的光纹。

【“一直被包裹在制服里，偶尔让身体晒晒太阳也不错呢。泳池派对很有意思，下次，跟我去海边吧？”】
Description.LocalizedString: !NoTextFound!

Description.SourceString:
霓之城的午夜电台迎来了一位特殊的主持，蝴蝶的翅脉又将在这灯火辉煌的不夜城掀起怎样的声浪呢？

【“清除这座城市的罪恶，就拿你们作为蝴蝶效应的第一循吧。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
A special host joins the midnight radio station of Neon City. What waves will the butterfly stir up in the dazzling city that never sleeps?

“To cleanse the city of its sins, you will serve as the first cycle of the butterfly effect.”

Description.SourceString:
作为新人搜查官的芙拉薇娅，因为自身特殊的弦能力，常被派去执行特工任务。她的所到之处，都会留下关于紫色幻蝶的传说。

【“啊，又受了点伤……还需要更加熟练一点才行啊。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
As a rookie investigator, Flavia is often sent on special missions due to her unique abilities. Everywhere she goes, she leaves behind the legend of the mystical purple butterflies.

"Ah, injured again... I've got to get better at this."

Description.SourceString:
芙拉薇娅作为欧泊代表选手，参加方程式竞赛时的装束。代表欧泊出战的居然是这位身居高位、传闻中的蝴蝶女士，让不少人深感意外。

【“比起欧泊的任务，这更像是我的个人爱好。至于实力……我的排名，你也看到了不是吗？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Taking everyone by surprise, Flavia suits up for the Formula Race as P.U.S's unexpected representative.

"This race is more of a personal thrill than a P.U.S. assignment. You've seen my rank, right?"

Description.SourceString:
传说中永夜古堡的主人，永生不灭、已在世上存活了数千年的貌美女子——芙拉薇娅。当天空中黑月升起，灵蝶会送来古堡的邀请函，此为邀约，亦是试探。

【“我既不吸食人血，也不惧怕阳光，如果对我真的如此好奇，不如亲自来看一看？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Legend tells of Flavia, the immortal mistress of the Castle of Eternal Night, a stunning beauty who has existed for millennia. When the black moon ascends, a spirit butterfly carries the castle's invitation—a challenge and a test.

"I neither drink blood nor fear sunlight. If you're truly curious, why not see for yourself?"

Description.SourceString:
如果对着月亮虔诚祈祷的话，月光女神就会回应你的呼唤。对待虔诚的信徒，她播撒恩赐；对投机取巧的小人，她降下神罚——这是这个世界的孩子们从小听着长大的童话故事。

【“神明造物，亦有物造的神明。我诞生于信仰，生命未有消亡，我便会永生。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Legends say that a heartfelt prayer to the moon will summon the Moon Goddess's response. To her devoted followers, she bestows blessings; to the deceptive, she unleashes divine punishment. It's the tale whispered to children through the ages.

"Divine creations and creations of the divine. Born from faith, as long as belief endures, so shall I."

TskinDescription.SourceString:
【美丽而高洁的月光女神是如此令人向往，她的眼眸深不见底、洞察一切，她的胸怀芬芳柔软、包容一切，而她处决罪人时又是如此狠戾果决，月光海一样的裙摆会抹除一切。她是所有行走在夜晚之人的共同信仰。

人们明明追寻着相同的目标，却走向了不同的结局。无数人说自己见过芙拉薇娅，有些人觉得她温柔怜悯，有些人觉得她冰冷无情，但很少有人能想起，这个世界根本看不见月亮。】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
The beautiful and noble Moon Goddess is truly captivating. Her deep, all-seeing eyes and gentle, accepting heart are enchanting, yet she becomes merciless and decisive when judging the guilty, erasing all with the sweep of her moonlit gown. She is the shared faith of all who walk the night.

People chase the same goal but arrive at different fates. Many claim to have seen Flavia; some find her kind and compassionate, others cold and unfeeling. Yet, few remember that in this world, the moon is never seen.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡的学生制服，是普雷顿地区最常见的款式，不过因为艾卡的身体温度很高，所以这身制服被她特别改出了几处用于散热的开口。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's school uniform is the most common style in the Preton region. However, due to Eika's high body temperature, she has specially modified it with ventilation openings.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡的制服夏季版配色。在苍郁的树木和青草间偷偷午睡。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's summer edition uniform. Perfect for napping among the dense trees and grass.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡的制服春季版配色。在漫天花瓣与花粉中匆匆前往校园。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's spring edition uniform. Rushing to campus amidst a flurry of petals and pollen.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡的制服秋季版配色。在缤纷落叶间寻味烤红薯的焦香。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's fall edition uniform. Amidst the falling leaves, she savors the aroma of roasted sweet potatoes.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡的制服冬季版配色。呼吸寒冷的空气时抬头遥望蔚蓝天空。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika’s winter uniform. Breathe in the cold air and gaze at the clear blue sky.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡的制服褪色版配色。洗涤的次数过多了，却总是不舍得丢弃。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's worn-out uniform. It has been worn and washed many times, but she still cherishes it.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡的制服香芋版配色。其实是和紫色衣物混洗后串色的结果。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika’s taro colored uniform. To be honest, it only turned purple after being put in the wrong wash basket.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡的制服早春版配色。是积雪消融的初春中，大地的第一抹新绿。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's early spring uniform. As the winter snow melts, green sprouts once more.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡在时尚服饰店打工时穿着的服装，以制服为基础，加入了外面大城市流行的粉色与暗色系的潮流设计。由于在店内还要兼顾服装模特，所以艾卡经常亲自上阵展示穿搭，据说带动的销量数据相当好看。
Description.LocalizedString: The outfit Eika wears while working at a fashion store, blending uniform style with trending pink and dark city designs. As an in-store model, Eika often showcases these outfits herself, reportedly boosting sales impressively.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡在咖啡店打工时穿着的服装，以制服为基础，采用了“店长每日推荐款”咖啡作为设计素材。由于在店内还要兼顾咖啡师，所以艾卡经常亲自上阵为顾客冲泡咖啡，据说每日售卖杯数相当可观。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's outfit for her café job, inspired by the "Manager's Daily Coffee Pick." As both a barista and model, Eika often prepares coffee for customers herself. Her sales figures are said to be impressive.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡在快餐店打工时穿着的服装，别出心裁地将高中制服和店员制服结合在一起，既符合行业标准，整体又显青春靓丽。据说上面红色滴液设计，源自艾卡开心地买了一大盘鸡块却不小心把辣椒酱打翻在上面时的悲伤经历。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's fast food uniform. This unique combo of a school and staff attire, helps her look the part and complements her youthful style. Rumor is that the dripping red feature was inspired by Eika's mournful experience of accidentally spilling chili sauce all over a big plate of chicken nuggets.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡在电玩店打工时穿着的服装，以制服为基础，使用了热门游戏机为主题的涂装。由于在店内还要兼顾游戏宣传，所以艾卡经常亲自上阵和各路高手进行PK，据说其节目效果相当不俗。
Description.LocalizedString: Eika wears this uniform when working part-time at the game store. It's accented with the color scheme of a popular gaming console. Promoting games is part of the job, so Eika often competes with pro gamers. It's become quite the attraction.

Description.SourceString: 艾卡在乡下农场打工时穿着的服装，以制服为基础，结合了草原的鲜绿与土壤的深厚。热情开朗的少女在农场里颇受欢迎，就连农场的机器牧犬也喜欢追在她的身后，或许是他们之间的赛跑游戏，亦或许是……艾卡单纯地怕狗？
Description.LocalizedString: Eika's uniform for her farm job. Based on a basic work uniform, it blends elements of meadow green and earthy tones. Her cheerful presence is a hit at the farm, even attracting the farm's robotic herding dog. Are they playing a friendly game... or is Eika simply afraid of dogs?

Description.SourceString:
艾卡亲自穿搭的户外潮服，大胆酷炫的搭配展现着女高中生的青春狂野。至于放学后她去了哪些地方“疯狂”，暂且保密。

【“女高中生的一天，在放学之后才算真正开始！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Eika’s self-styled outdoor gear showcases bold and edgy fashion that embodies the wild spirit of a high school girl. Exactly where she "lets loose" after school is her little secret.

“The day of a high school student only begins after school!”

Description.SourceString:
艾卡在天文馆兼职搬运工作时的服装，由她本人亲自搭配，集合了各种科幻电影的要素，以及少女对星海的浪漫想象。在天文馆的氛围中，艾卡忽然觉得，能做上宇宙送货员或许是一件很酷的事情。

【“如果咱家的餐馆遍布了全宇宙，我是不是得在各个星球之间送外卖啊？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Eika put together this outfit for her side job at the planetarium, blending elements from sci-fi movies with a girl's dreamy imagination of the stars. While working inside the planetarium, Eika realizes that being a galactic courier could be the coolest job ever.

"If our family restaurant spanned the universe, would I have to deliver food among planets?"

Description.SourceString:
这个夏日的海面大概率不会风平浪静，因为有火花小鱼的闪亮出场。她的炽焰与热情将在海底掀起一阵热烈激昂的风暴。

【“想一睹被焚风染红的海底吗？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The summer sea is unlikely to remain calm, as the brilliant luster of spark fish takes center stage. Through fire and passion, they ignite a glorious storm beneath the waves.

“I can show you a sight - the seabed dyed red by hot winds.”

Description.SourceString:
专属于艾卡的打歌服，面具上的小兔子软萌可爱，但格纹蓬蓬裙和吊带背心又彰显出摇滚的态度。面具下的偶像艾卡，此刻是什么样的表情呢？

【“虽然总是用面具来遮掩表情，但是艾卡对粉丝的一片真心，你们能感受到吧？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Eika's exclusive idol costume. The bunny on her mask might be soft and cuddly, but the plaid puffy skirt and tank top give a real rockstar vibe. Just what kind of expression could this idol's mask be hiding?

"My face may be hidden behind a mask, but you can feel my sincerity, right?"

Description.SourceString:
女高中生的假日，当然要在游乐园度过！为赴玛德雷娜之约，艾卡设计了新的服装，戴上了小怪兽帽子、背上了喷火龙背包。有这两个小家伙帮忙，今天无论是打气球、抓娃娃还是捞金鱼，她都不会输的！

【“无敌的艾卡大王，在游乐园也战无不胜！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
For a high schooler, the amusement park is the perfect holiday spot! Eika put together an outfit with a cute monster hat and dragon backpack for her day with Maddelena. Armed with her playful sidekicks, she's ready to conquer any park game!

"Eika the Invincible reigns undefeated!"

Description.SourceString:
在没有病痛的新世界中，也有着疗愈他人“心病”的医护人员，剪刀手是其中手法激进的一派，在这一过程中，某位平凡的女高中生依旧需要隐藏“身份”。

【“火焰将净化，并疗愈一切。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
In a world free of physical ailments, there are healers for the heart. The Scissors are known as radicals. And so, a regular high school girl must still conceal her true "identity."

"Fire purifies. Fire heals all."

Description.SourceString:
她的烈焰远比这片沙海要更为炽热，随着火舞者的舞步扬起灰烬，一场热潮即将席卷而来。

【“为了获得新的力量，有时我们需要烧毁旧的躯壳。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Her flames burn hotter than the desert sands. As she moves, ashes rise, heralding an incoming wave of heat.

“One must burn the old shell to gain new strength.”

Description.SourceString:
任何时间，任何地点，任何困难，都会为你解决！照亮普雷顿之心的火焰，蓄势于日珥装甲之中，静待时机，一飞冲天。

【“‘英雄’……在说我吗？嘿嘿，终于等到这个从小向往的头衔落在我头上啦。不过，内心居然没有很激动？大概是守护普雷顿的信念，早已与‘艾卡’融为一体了吧！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Ready to tackle any challenge, anywhere, anytime. The fire that lights up Preton resides within the Solar Armor, waiting for the perfect moment to soar.

"Am I really the 'hero' they're talking about? Hehe, I've dreamed of this title forever. Strange though, I'm not as thrilled as I imagined. Maybe it's because the passion to protect Preton has always been part of who I am!"

TskinDescription.SourceString:
【不知名的怪兽突然袭击了普雷顿中学！外貌憨态可掬，甚至能从中找到许多可爱小动物的影子，但当它眉头紧皱，呲出愤怒的门牙时，那股气势几乎能将整座教学楼撼动。

“现在，英雄该登场了！”

以玻璃的碎裂声作为前兆，身着日珥装甲的英雄少女从高层教室一跃而出，挡在了众人身前。

少女身姿所到之处，皆有火焰燃烧留下的残影。灰色的庞大怪兽面前，燃起了代表勇敢与正义的火焰。

“爸爸妈妈和剪刀手的大家送给我这个礼物时，告诉我，是时候站出来堂堂正正守护普雷顿了。”

“而击败你，就是日珥战姬的第一个任务！”
——
看着睡梦中也不忘紧紧抱着礼物盒的女儿，艾卡的妈妈又好笑又无奈，只是伸出手给艾卡掖好了被角。

晚安，我的小英雄，普雷顿未来的大英雄。】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
An unknown creature suddenly attacked Preton High! At first glance, it might look endearing, reminiscent of cute little animals, but when it furrows its brows and flashes its angry fangs, its presence could shake an entire school building.

"Alright, time for a hero to make an entrance!"

With the sound of shattering glass as her cue, the hero clad in her Solar Armor leaped from the upper classroom, landing right in front of everyone.

Wherever she moved, fire trailed behind her like a dance of blazing shadows. In front of the massive gray beast, flames of courage and justice ignited.

"When my parents and the whole crew from The Scissors gave me this gift, they told me it was time to step up and protect Preton with honor."

"And taking you down is the first mission of the Solar Maiden!"

Description.SourceString:
任何时间，任何地点，任何困难，都会为你解决！照亮普雷顿之心的火焰，蓄势于日珥装甲之中，静待时机，一飞冲天。

【“‘英雄’……在说我吗？嘿嘿，终于等到这个从小向往的头衔落在我头上啦。不过，内心居然没有很激动？大概是守护普雷顿的信念，早已与‘艾卡’融为一体了吧！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Ready to tackle any challenge, anywhere, anytime. The fire that lights up Preton resides within the Solar Armor, waiting for the perfect moment to soar.

"Am I really the 'hero' they're talking about? Hehe, I've dreamed of this title forever. Strange though, I'm not as thrilled as I imagined. Maybe it's because the passion to protect Preton has always been part of who I am!"

TskinDescription.SourceString:
【不知名的怪兽突然袭击了普雷顿中学！外貌憨态可掬，甚至能从中找到许多可爱小动物的影子，但当它眉头紧皱，呲出愤怒的门牙时，那股气势几乎能将整座教学楼撼动。

“现在，英雄该登场了！”

以玻璃的碎裂声作为前兆，身着日珥装甲的英雄少女从高层教室一跃而出，挡在了众人身前。

少女身姿所到之处，皆有火焰燃烧留下的残影。灰色的庞大怪兽面前，燃起了代表勇敢与正义的火焰。

“爸爸妈妈和剪刀手的大家送给我这个礼物时，告诉我，是时候站出来堂堂正正守护普雷顿了。”

“而击败你，就是日珥战姬的第一个任务！”
——
看着睡梦中也不忘紧紧抱着礼物盒的女儿，艾卡的妈妈又好笑又无奈，只是伸出手给艾卡掖好了被角。

晚安，我的小英雄，普雷顿未来的大英雄。】
TskinDescription.LocalizedString:
An unknown creature suddenly attacked Preton High! At first glance, it might look endearing, reminiscent of cute little animals, but when it furrows its brows and flashes its angry fangs, its presence could shake an entire school building.

"Alright, time for a hero to make an entrance!"

With the sound of shattering glass as her cue, the hero clad in her Solar Armor leaped from the upper classroom, landing right in front of everyone.

Wherever she moved, fire trailed behind her like a dance of blazing shadows. In front of the massive gray beast, flames of courage and justice ignited.

"When my parents and the whole crew from The Scissors gave me this gift, they told me it was time to step up and protect Preton with honor."

"And taking you down is the first mission of the Solar Maiden!"

Description.SourceString:
任何时间，任何地点，任何困难，都会为你解决！照亮普雷顿之心的火焰，蓄势于日珥装甲之中，静待时机，一飞冲天。

【“‘英雄’……在说我吗？嘿嘿，终于等到这个从小向往的头衔落在我头上啦。不过，内心居然没有很激动？大概是守护普雷顿的信念，早已与‘艾卡’融为一体了吧！”】

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝进行植物研究时穿着的研究服，款式干练而优雅，充分凸显了她的学者气质。
Description.LocalizedString: Fragrans' smart and elegant lab coat is exactly what you'd expect from a person with such a scholarly temperament.

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝所穿研究服的换色款，清新的绿色仿佛刚冒头的茶叶嫩芽。
Description.LocalizedString: An alternative color scheme of Fragrans' lab coat, in a refreshing green reminiscent of freshly sprouted tea leaves.

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝所穿研究服的换色款，颜色之纯净，仿佛经过提纯一般。
Description.LocalizedString: An alternative color scheme of Fragrans' lab coat, featuring a purity akin to refined essence.

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝所穿研究服的换色款，紫罗兰在夜色中绽放，如美酒般让人陶醉。
Description.LocalizedString: An alternative color scheme of Fragrans' lab coat. The violet blooms in the night, as intoxicating as fine wine.

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝所穿研究服的换色款，深玫红色更能衬托她的成熟气质。
Description.LocalizedString: An alternative color scheme of Fragrans' lab coat. Its deep rose color highlights her mature elegance.

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝所穿研究服的换色款，秋叶般的色调预示着即将到来的冬天。
Description.LocalizedString: An alternative color scheme of Fragrans' lab coat, with tones reminiscent of autumn leaves, foreshadowing winter's arrival.

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝所穿研究服的换色款，蓝色不止代表忧郁，也代表着内心的平静。
Description.LocalizedString: An alternative color scheme for Fragrans' lab coat, where blue symbolizes not just melancholy, but also inner peace.

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝所穿研究服的换色款，辛盈清苦，回味无穷。
Description.LocalizedString: An alternative color scheme for Faglan's lab coat, offering a fresh bitterness that lingers intriguingly.

Description.SourceString:
“每种咖啡豆都有不同的香味呢。”珐格兰丝把面前的咖啡杯推到艾卡面前，“这一款闻起来有花香和果香，应该会很好喝。”
“果香？是水果那样甜甜的味道吗！……哇哇哇好酸！！！”
Description.LocalizedString:
"Each type of coffee bean has a unique aroma." Fragrans places the cup of coffee in front of Eika. "This one has floral and fruity notes. It should be delightful."

"Really? Like, as sweet as fruit?... Ah! It's so sour!!!"

Description.SourceString:
春天是珐格兰丝最喜欢的季节，万物复苏，生机盎然。
“今年的第一款香氛，就制作樱花香味的吧。”
Description.LocalizedString:
Spring, full of vitality and renewal, is Fragrans' favorite season.

"Let's make the first fragrance of this year a sakura scent."

Description.SourceString:
在剪刀手一行人的古堡探险挑战中，最快走出来的居然是戴着眼罩的珐格兰丝。
“蝙蝠用回声定位，我用味道定位……古堡外的空气，确实要更清新一些呢。”
Description.LocalizedString:
During The Scissors' castle exploration, Fragrans, to everyone's surprise, was the fastest to emerge, even with a blindfold on.
"Bats use sound; I use scent... The air outside the castle is indeed much fresher."

Description.SourceString:
在和剪刀手的其他伙伴一起参观完水族馆后，珐格兰丝给自己制作了一件以水母为主题的装扮。
“水母……像盛开在海底，幽蓝的花。”
Description.LocalizedString:
After an aquarium trip with her friends, Fragrans made herself a jellyfish-themed outfit.
“Jellyfish... they strike me as light blue flowers blooming on the seabed.”

Description.SourceString: 珐格兰丝探访香雪海时穿着的服装。雪光如昼的冬日，梅花如期盛放在她飞舞的衣角上，弥散出了一缕幽香。
Description.LocalizedString: The outfit Fragrans wore when visiting the Sea of Blossoms. On that snowy day, plum blossoms bloomed on the corners of her fluttering clothes, covering her in their faint scent.

Description.SourceString: 空气本身是没有味道的，我们闻到的气味实际上是细小的分子，而现在这清新，芬芳的气息来源于柑橘的果肉与油脂，就当作她赠予我们的礼物吧。
Description.LocalizedString: The air itself is odorless; what we smell are tiny molecules. This fresh, fragrant scent comes from the pulp and oils of citrus fruits—consider it a gift from her.

Description.SourceString:
珐格兰丝的医护装扮，无论她本人对这类穿着是否习惯，要做的事情都是一样的，治愈病患，抚平创痛。

【“请好好休息一下吧。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Fragrans' medical attire, whether she's accustomed to it or not, serves the same purpose: to heal and soothe.

"It's important for you to rest well."

Description.SourceString:
跟随地图的指引，在科斯迷特的沙漠中寻找传说中的香氛原料，为了抵抗炎热的天气，珐格兰丝也换上了一身清凉的装扮。

【“跟着香气走吧，带着眼罩是看不见地图的。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Fragrans follows the map in search of mythic ingredients in the Cosmite desert. She has changed into a cooler outfit to endure the scorching heat.

“Follow the scent. You can't read maps with a blindfold on.”

Description.SourceString:
斑斓的光芒从这座城市溢出，随着射灯的角度，映向漆黑的夜空。在那昙华般绽放的光幕中央，那道身影倾听着城市的声浪，也轻嗅着城市的味道。

【“误解，仇恨，暴力，这片土地不该一直被这些缠绕。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
From myriad angles, the city's vivid lights streak into the night sky. In the center of the blooming light stands a figure listening to the sounds of the city and taking in its scents.

“Misunderstanding, hatred, violence... I must rid the world of such things.”

Description.SourceString:
珐格兰丝很喜欢冬日的雪夜，尤其是站在路灯下，仰望雪花一片片飘落。那片幽深的蓝却能孕育如此纯净的白，也许这就是自然的馈赠吧。

【“当雪花落在你的掌心，他们不是消失了，而是融入为了你身体的一部分。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Fragrans loves snowy winter nights. She often stands under a streetlight, gazing at the sky as snowflakes fall. To think such pure white comes from the deep blue sky - perhaps it is nature's gift.

“When snowflakes fall into your palm, they don't disappear; they become a part of you.”

Description.SourceString:
在沐春节到来之际，珐格兰丝以‘锦鲤’为主题设计了新的作战服。主色调为黑白，点缀一抹优雅的红，如同水墨画中跃出的一尾锦鲤。

【“说我像是水墨画中走出来的人吗？哎呀，能被当作古迹的再现，也不枉我花费不少时间设计这套作战服呢。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
To celebrate Spring Blessing, Fragrans has designed a new combat uniform inspired by the koi fish. The mostly black and white uniform is accented with an elegant touch of red like a koi leaping out of an ink painting.

"Are you saying I look like I just walked out of a painting? Thank you. Being considered a personification of ancient art makes all the effort I spent designing this outfit worthwhile."

Description.SourceString:
永夜古堡背后的长廊通往一片花园，里面种植着无数奇异诡丽的植物。人们总是好奇，花园的主人珐格兰丝是如何将这些植物打理得如此繁茂的，却没有人敢真的上前询问。

【“这些植物的养料是什么？当然是我制作的培养剂了。唔？你的表情怎么有点失望？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The corridor behind the Castle of Eternal Night leads to a garden lush with countless strange and eerie plants. People often wonder how the mistress, Fragrans, keeps them so vibrant, but none dare to ask.

"How do I nourish the plants? My special cultivation agent, of course. Hm? Why do you look disappointed?"

Description.SourceString: 欧泊对忧雾进行“监管”后，特意为她定制了一款带有弦能抑制功能的战斗服。是限制，也是一种保护。
Description.LocalizedString: P.U.S tailored a special combat suit for Yugiri with string energy suppression, serving as both shield and restraint.

Description.SourceString: 忧雾所穿着的作战服换色款。在原本的基础款式上增添了一抹浅紫，据说这是忧雾喜欢的颜色。
Description.LocalizedString: A recolored version of Yugiri's combat suit. It features a touch of soft purple, apparently her favorite color.

Description.SourceString: 忧雾所穿着的作战服换色款。色调清新淡雅，春天到来的时候，如果有机会穿着它去踏青，感觉应该会很不错。
Description.LocalizedString: A recolored version of Yugiri's combat suit. With a fresh and elegant tone, it would be perfect for a spring outing.

Description.SourceString: 忧雾所穿着的作战服换色款。点缀了充满少女气息的粉色，忧雾穿上意外很合适。
Description.LocalizedString: A recolored version of Yugiri's combat suit. Adorned with youthful pink accents, it surprisingly suits her well.

Description.SourceString: 忧雾所穿着的作战服换色款。深绿的色调如同漫步在森林中，头顶的阳光被遮蔽，只留一地斑驳。
Description.LocalizedString: A recolored version of Yugiri's combat suit. The deep green shade resembles a stroll through a forest, where sunlight is filtered and dappled.

Description.SourceString: 忧雾所穿着的作战服换色款。深粉的色调让整体气质都更显成熟，似乎在战斗中也更可靠了。
Description.LocalizedString: A recolored version of Yugiri's combat suit. The deep pink shade adds a mature vibe, making her seem more reliable in battle.

Description.SourceString: 忧雾所穿着的作战服换色款。淡淡的黄色，像一颗还未成熟的酸杏，还需要一些成长的时间。
Description.LocalizedString: A recolored version of Yugiri's combat suit. Delicate yellow, like an unripe apricot, needing more time to mature.

Description.SourceString: 比起醇香苦涩的咖啡，忧雾更喜欢在别人制作完拿铁后，用剩余的牛奶给自己做一份热乎乎的蒸汽奶。不苦，很香，就像把云朵吞进肚子里的感觉。
Description.LocalizedString: Yugiri prefers to make herself some warm, frothy steamed milk using the leftover milk after others prepare their lattes. It's not bitter but wonderfully fragrant, like swallowing a cloud.

Description.SourceString: 在蛋糕里加上足够多的抹茶粉，本该入口即化的甜蜜，也变得有些苦涩。还好有橙片的点缀，让这份苦涩的回味保留一丝甘甜。
Description.LocalizedString: Adding plenty of matcha powder to the cake turns its usual melt-in-your-mouth sweetness into a touch of bitterness. Thankfully, the orange slices add a hint of sweetness to the aftertaste.

Description.SourceString:
再危险的任务，忧雾也都是面不改色地直接接受。

“这很难吗？我其实觉得还好。危险的地方，就让我去探索吧。”
Description.LocalizedString:
No matter how dangerous the mission, Yugiri accepts it without flinching.

"Is it hard? I think it's fine. Leave the dangerous places to me."

Description.SourceString:
春天到了，欧泊组织团建，也带上了总是闭门不出的忧雾，还为她特意定做了新衣服，忧雾有些别扭地穿上了。

“应该不会很奇怪吧，我穿上的样子。”
Description.LocalizedString:
Spring has arrived, and P.U.S planned a team-building event, bringing along Yugiri, who rarely leaves her room. They even made her a special outfit. She put it on somewhat awkwardly.

"I hope it doesn't look too strange on me."

Description.SourceString:
忧雾喜欢紫罗兰盛开的季节，这样她就能躺在那片与她相称的紫色海洋里，任由无尽的浪漫与幻想在眼前翻涌。

【“或许在梦境里，我能抓住幸福的机会。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Yugiri loves the season when violets bloom. She could lie in a sea of purple that matches her perfectly. Endless romance and dreams would wash over her.

"Maybe in dreams, I can grasp a chance for happiness."

Description.SourceString:
忧雾仍然记得那曾经困住自己的黑暗，但在浩瀚的孤独中，她依然倔强地寻到了自己前进的方向。
“你看到海底的星星了吗，那是小水母努力寻找光的证明。”
Description.LocalizedString:
Yugiri still remembers the darkness that once trapped her, yet in vast solitude, she stubbornly found her way forward.

"Do you see the stars under the sea? They are proof of the little jellyfish striving to find light."

Description.SourceString: 梅花落在枝头，融化后，就是下一个春天。
Description.LocalizedString: Plum petals rest on branches, melting to usher in the coming spring.

Description.SourceString: 如幽魂潜伏于暗影，如死神般降临。踪迹难寻，却又无处不在——正如死亡本身。
Description.LocalizedString: She lurks in the shadows like a phantom, descending on her victims as if she were the Grim Reaper. Her presence is elusive yet omnipresent, just like death itself.

Description.SourceString:
玛拉在希达半岛行动时特制的作战服，参考了当地传说中的经典款式，既能完成隐匿作战的需要，也能在行动中获得当地普通民众的支持。

【“行于黑暗者并非只能凝望深渊，也有机会在长夜中点燃光明。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Mara's custom combat suit for her mission on the Seeda Peninsula is inspired by legendary local designs. This suit excels in stealth operations and simultaneously earns the support of the local community.

"Those who walk in darkness need not only gaze into the abyss; they have the power to ignite a light in the long night."

Description.SourceString:
背负着无数传闻和秘密、已经消失许久的亡灵女爵玛拉再次出现，是在永夜古堡的晚宴上。显然，这次灵蝶邀请来了一位贵客。

【“哈，闯入者？现在，看着我的邀请函再说一次？”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Mara, the Undead Countess surrounded by rumors and secrets, has reappeared at the grand banquet of the Castle of Eternal Night. Clearly, the spirit butterfly has brought a distinguished guest.

"An intruder? Seriously? Look at my invitation before you say another word."

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的备用作战服，行走在夜色中时，只会留下一道苍青的影子。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's spare combat uniform in azure. She leaves behind but a shadow as she moves in the dark of the night.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的备用作战服，浓墨重彩的一笔蓝，正如夜空深邃的眼眸。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's spare combat uniform in blue. The bold, deep color is as profound as the impression she makes.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的备用作战服，深重而沉稳的绿色亦能彰显她的个性。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's spare combat uniform in green, reflecting her strong personality.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的备用作战服，紫色既能代表高贵优雅，也能彰显冷酷与强势。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's spare combat uniform in purple, symbolizing her elegance while exuding a sense of authority.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的备用作战服，一抹焦黄，伴随着她行走在苍茫大地上。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's spare combat uniform in yellow. The striking color accompanies her as she walks across the vast earth.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的备用作战服，在紫色的基础上增加了一抹红调。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's spare combat uniform with a touch of red to its purple base.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的个人定制服装。当一线阳光穿过重重山脉，绿意也随之盎然。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's custom outfit in green, resembling vibrant greenery that flourishes as a ray of sunlight pierces through towering mountains.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的改装作战服，设计灵感来源于玛拉小时候常喝的家乡饮料，虽然这种味道似乎有些过于刺激了。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's modified combat uniform inspired by her favorite childhood drink from her hometown, though its taste might be considered a bit too intense.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的改装作战服，设计灵感来源于蝙蝠。日常生活中，玛拉也同蝙蝠一般，时常昼伏夜出。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's modified combat uniform inspired by bats. Much like bats, Mara often remains hidden during the day and active at night.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的改装作战服，如同一道黄色的闪电，预警着极端危险的到来。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's modified combat uniform in yellow, resembling a lightning bolt that warns of impending danger.

Description.SourceString: 玛拉的改装作战服，如同随机波动的音量般，带有迷幻的电子色彩。
Description.LocalizedString: Mara's modified combat uniform featuring psychedelic electronic patterns, resembling fluctuating sound waves.

Description.SourceString: 作为欧泊工程部的部长，蕾欧娜对一切诞生于此的建筑负责。每当她作为监理出现在施工现场，都会引起下属们的窃窃私语：“部长真的很严格！”
Description.LocalizedString: As head of the P.U.S Engineering Department, Leona oversees every project with unwavering dedication. Whenever she steps onto a construction site, whispers follow: "The boss doesn't miss a thing!"

Description.SourceString: 蕾欧娜的备用作战服，质朴的军绿色凸显出她严谨认真的性格。
Description.LocalizedString: Leona's spare combat uniform in army green, highlighting her disciplined and serious personality.

Description.SourceString: 蕾欧娜的备用作战服，辽阔的原野一望无际，静静等待来访者的探索。
Description.LocalizedString: Leona's spare combat uniform in green, inspired by vast prairies that wait for visitors in silence.

Description.SourceString: 蕾欧娜的备用作战服，苍蓝天穹照耀着的，是建设者勇敢而进取的心。
Description.LocalizedString: Leona's spare combat uniform in azure. The vast blue sky reflects the boldness and ambitions of builders.

Description.SourceString: 蕾欧娜的备用作战服，九层之台，起于累土，看似最普通的岩石，其实是一切的基础。
Description.LocalizedString: Leona's spare combat uniform in brown. Towering structures are built layer by layer. Ordinary rocks are the foundation of all things.

Description.SourceString: 蕾欧娜的备用作战服，深玫粉色让她的气质更显稳重亲和。
Description.LocalizedString: Leona's spare combat uniform in pink, enhancing her composed and approachable aura.

Description.SourceString: 蕾欧娜的备用作战服，绛紫的优雅在她身上显露无遗。
Description.LocalizedString: Leona's spare combat uniform in purple, exuding her elegance.

Description.SourceString:
除了负责建筑建造之外，欧泊工程部的职能也包括前期的实地调查和勘探。至于这次的目标地点为什么是一栋古堡……这就是另一个故事了。

【“工程部全体成员，跟紧我，报数！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Besides handling construction, P.U.S Engineering is also responsible for preliminary site investigations and surveys. As for why the target location this time is an ancient castle... well, that is another story.

“All engineering personnel, follow me and number off!”

Description.SourceString:
虽然知道施工现场有备用发电装置，但在每天开工前，检查两遍设备的状态和设置是否正确，已经成为了蕾欧娜的固定习惯。

【“很好，电力充足，随时可以开工！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Although Leona knows there are backup generators at the construction site, she still makes it a habit to check the equipment and its settings twice before starting work each day.

“We've got sufficient power. We can start anytime!”

Description.SourceString:
蕾欧娜认真细致的工作习惯显然也延续到了生活中，那些有幸坐上她副驾驶的人，都要在享受旅途前接受一番拷问。

【“安全带系好了吧？再检查一遍。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Leona's meticulous work habits extend into her personal life as well. Anyone lucky enough to sit in her passenger seat must first go through a round of questioning before enjoying the ride.

“Have you fastened your seatbelt? Check again.”

Description.SourceString:
这套制服的设计灵感来源于某次工程部的异域探索行动，神秘的流沙、高大的石柱和柱子上栩栩如生的灵兽给蕾欧娜留下了深刻的印象。

【“这些都是古老文明留下的印记，如果可以的话，希望能保留到新生的建筑上。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
The design of this uniform is inspired by one of P.U.S Engineering's exotic exploration missions. The mysterious shifting sands, towering stone pillars, and vividly carved mythical beasts left a lasting impression on Leona.

“These are the marks of an ancient civilization. If possible, I would like to preserve them in our new buildings.”

Description.SourceString:
“幻梦求真录”历史文化展览在沐春期间连续举办，在卡丘人之中掀起了一股仿古风潮。人们仿照古壁画中仙人的服装制式，设计了一系列典雅、精致、飘逸的服装。

【“咳咳，别一直盯着我看，大家回到工作岗位上吧。虽然节日将近，但还是要保持工作状态啊。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
During the Spring Festival, the "Dreams to Reality" exhibit inspired a trend among the Strinovians, leading to a collection of refined garments modeled after ancient mural attire.

"Ahem, stop staring at me and get back to work, everyone. The festival is approaching, but let's stay focused on our tasks."

Description.SourceString:
蕾欧娜作为电玩比赛现场工作人员所穿着的服装，展露出了她率性洒脱的另一面。相信在蕾欧娜的维护下，现场的秩序一定会井井有条……吧？

【“那位打扮奇特、行踪可疑的先生！请停在原地，接受工作人员的问询！诶！不许跑！”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Leona's outfit as a gaming event staff member reveals her carefree side. With her managing the event, everything should be organized... right?

"Hey, you with the strange look and suspicious behavior! Stop for questioning! Hey! No running!"

Description.SourceString:
欧泊的换装舞会，忧雾也获得了参加的资格，这次为她准备服装的是伊薇特。羞涩的研究员少女举起轻盈的芭蕾舞裙，小声说：“希望你喜欢……那个，忧雾穿上一定很好看……”

【“明明跟我说话都紧张得不行，却坚持要为我准备衣服，说什么‘之前也有人为她准备过’。欧泊的人果然还是很奇怪啊。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Yugiri qualified to attend the P.U.S. ball, with Yvette preparing her outfit. The shy researcher girl held up a delicate ballet dress, whispering, "I hope you like it... Um, it'll look great on you, Yugiri."

"Though she's so nervous talking to me, she insisted on preparing the outfit, saying 'someone did it for her before.' People at P.U.S. really are quite peculiar."

Description.SourceString:
在设计自己的专属打歌服时，忧雾展现出了对复古风格的强烈喜爱。最终呈现出的效果，俨然是千禧年海报上的少女偶像。

【“平时只能在杂志上看到这种装扮……偶尔打扮成这样，感觉也挺不错。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
While designing her stage outfit, Yugiri expresses her love for vintage aesthetics. The final product is reminiscent of a Y2K-era idol from a retro poster.

"I usually only see this style in magazines... but dressing up like this once in a while feels pretty nice."

Description.SourceString:
又是一年沐春节到来，欧泊为今年表现优异的员工设计了新的制服，忧雾也分到一件。虽然嘴上不说，但其实能看出来她很喜欢。

【“特意为我设计的吗？我说怎么突然问了我那么多关于喜好的问题。我确实很喜欢……你们费心了。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Spring Blessing has come again, and P.U.S designed a special uniform for its standout staff, including Yugiri. Her fondness for it is clear even if she doesn't say much.

"Was this custom-made for me? That explains all the questions about my tastes. I genuinely like it... I appreciate your consideration."

Description.SourceString:
忧雾为假日出行设计的服装，粉色制服裙和可爱的游乐设施相映成趣。奇趣游乐园门口，忧雾被两个女孩叫住了，一张门票被塞进掌心，一段奇妙旅程就此展开。

【“她们喊着“买二送一”、“薅羊毛”什么的就冲上来了。不过，和她们度过的一天，很开心很开心。”】
Description.LocalizedString:
Yugiri's holiday ensemble combines a pink outfit with playful park vibes. Outside the amusement park, two girls handed her a ticket, kicking off an enchanting adventure.

"They excitedly talked about discounts and deals. The day with them was just delightful."
